Kylix.name: 欢宴魔 Kylix
Kylix.publicNotes:
这些外表优雅、形似凡人的欢宴魔，或称为斟酒魔鬼，极少掩盖其自身的地狱本质，不过他却更偏爱以高雅精致的服装凸显其形体的美感与对称。他们仿佛是闲言碎语与机智攀谈相结合的舞蹈，在微笑的调情暗示间许下半真半假的友谊。无论他去往何处，总是能迅速与人交好，单是其存在似乎就能平息叛乱与冲突。斟酒魔鬼是占领的“脸面”；凭借魔性的魅力，他能剥夺参与叛乱的革命者，使伴侣分隔开来，窃走襁褓中的孩童，并在完成这一切的同时得到受害者的感谢。

斟酒魔鬼塑造着艺术与文化，运用其在欢宴与行乐上的天赋，诱使宾客及随从堕入他邪恶的魅力之中。斟酒魔鬼倡导地狱乃是文明的壁垒；他凭借着闪烁的器皿与不经意却诚恳的奉承，提醒对方地狱才是最佳的归宿，人们无需畏惧其法则。
Kylix.allSaves: 对抗魔法时所有豁免获得+1点状态

False Friend.name: 虚假朋友 False Friend
False Friend.description: 欢宴魔的非伤害法术获得晦匿特征。

Raise a Glass.name: 举杯致意 Raise a Glass
Raise a Glass.description: 当欢宴魔正手持一杯饮料，并且没有持用武器或穿戴护甲时，他会持续受到@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8xRzLhwGL7Dgy3EZ]（@Check[will|dc:21]）的保护。若欢宴魔打破了圣域术，那么魔鬼必须停止采取任何敌对动作达10分钟之后，该效果才会恢复。此外，当欢宴魔受到圣域术保护时，他能投掷交涉技能来决定先攻。

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法时所有豁免+1点状态 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Courteous Causerie.name: 礼貌漫谈 Courteous Causerie
Courteous Causerie.description: 欢宴魔尝试@Check[deception]、@Check[diplomacy]、@Check[performance]或@Check[society]检定，并将其结果与60尺射程内的至多四个生物的意志DC进行比较。成功时，这些生物会陷入持续1轮的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]。欢宴魔能维持该效果，增加该迷魂的持续时间1轮，至多增加至1分钟。当该迷魂结束时，受影响的生物都会临时免疫礼貌漫谈，持续1小时。

Hand in Glove.name: 密切配合 Hand in Glove
Hand in Glove.description: 若敌人同时位于自身以及一个盟友的触及之内，欢宴魔就能夹击该敌人；欢宴魔与其盟友不需要分别站在敌人的对侧。欢宴魔的盟友也能从该效果中获益，但仅限与欢宴魔夹击敌人时有效，不适用于其他盟友间的夹击判定。夹击的其他需求条件仍需要得到满足。

Sparkling Wit.name: 妙语连珠 Sparkling Wit
Sparkling Wit.description: 若生物陷入了对欢宴魔的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]，那么该生物对欢宴魔来说还处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]。

Velavi.name: 藏典魔 Velavi
Velavi.publicNotes:
知识即是力量，没有人能比藏典魔更为敏锐地意识到这条真理。这些抄书员以及次级学者奉命掌管着泰吉亚（Stygia）的谎言学院（Academies of Lies）中深不可测的浩瀚馆藏。藏典魔是图书馆的门面，负责接待访客并决定是否批准其请求。其组织能力在地狱中堪称翘楚，并且她善于长期记忆，因此能在宛如其家园的图书馆内以令人惊异的速度穿梭。藏典魔还为地狱提供着另一项至关重要的服务：若有其他魔鬼作出了具有价值的发现，他们应当向学院报告，然后由藏典魔记录在卷轴或者由藏典魔亲手用活体血肉制作的书籍中。

每名藏典魔都非常熟悉她们所在的图书馆的藏书，她们能不受限制地访问其他学院的档案。那些在地狱中寻求信息的人可能会试图寻求藏典魔的帮助，但是藏典魔在让渡任何信息之前都会提出极其高昂的代价——即便如此，知识也几乎总是单向流往藏典魔，因为她们在分享信息时总会设下诸般诡计。司书魔鬼是保管人、守门人与守护者；藏典魔极少会与高阶魔鬼之外的存在分享知识，但即便对方是高阶魔鬼，也必须对其使用威逼利诱等手段。
Velavi.allSaves: 对抗魔法时所有豁免+1点状态

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法时所有豁免+1点状态 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Frightening Shush.name: 骇人噤声 Frightening Shush
Frightening Shush.description:
藏典魔发出威胁，作出让人噤声的动作。30尺内的生物必须尝试@Check[will|dc:18]豁免。藏典魔在[[/br 1d4 #Recharge Frightening Shush]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用骇人噤声。

大成功 该生物不会受到额外影响。

成功 该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 1}。

失败 该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 2}。只要该生物还处于此能力造成的惊惧状态，对藏典魔来说就还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]。

大失败 同失败，而且该生物在惊惧期间还无法发出任何声音，就如同受到@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gIdDLrbswTV3OBJy]的法术影响一般。

Novice Hellknight Armiger.name: 见习地狱骑士扈从 Novice Hellknight Armiger

Goblin Scuttle.name: 地精快步 Goblin Scuttle
Goblin Scuttle.description:
触发 一名地精盟友在与布拉克纳普相邻的位置结束一个移动动作

效果 布拉克纳普快步。

Evoke Fault.name: 揭示弱点 Evoke Fault
Evoke Fault.description: 布拉克纳普的先祖精魂告知他30尺内一名敌人的弱点。直到他的回合结束，布拉克纳普下一次针对该目标的打击，其攻击检定获得+1状态加值，且该打击造成额外1d6点精准伤害。在他的回合结束时，布拉克纳普陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 Clumsy 1}，持续1分钟。若布拉克纳普在处于笨拙状态时使用揭示弱点，其笨拙状态数值增加1，最高为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 Clumsy 3}。

Vision of Goblins' Fall.name: 地精陨落幻景 Vision of Goblins' Fall
Vision of Goblins' Fall.description:
频率 每10分钟1次

效果 布拉克纳普触碰一名敌人，使其体验尖叫森林的地精在地精血战期间遭受的痛苦。目标承受@Damage[3d6[mental]]伤害（@Check[will|dc:21|basic]豁免）。豁免失败的生物还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 1}（大失败时为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 2}）。

Insidiator.name: 构陷魔 Insidiator
Insidiator.publicNotes:
这些魔鬼来自九层地狱的第一层，负责诱捕那些容易被诱惑的人、以及编织导致凡人灵魂堕落的阴谋来为上级服务。构陷魔常被招募来设置钓鱼行动，诱使凡人犯下可怖的罪行，或者去揭露其他魔族对手的诡计。他们乐于目睹猎物落入其精心设计的圈套，并且可能会为了制定完美的计划而耗费数年——尽管效率最高的人才更有可能在地狱的阶级中攀升。

\n

构陷魔的狡诈天赋延伸到了自身的物质形体上。其蝙蝠一般的翅膀看似宛如薄纱一般，却犹如它所模仿的蜘蛛网一般，十分适合用于捕获猎物，能够黏住敌人并把它困于肉搏战中。当情绪变化或者情势所迫时，诱捕魔鬼还可以改变皮肤与翅膀的颜色以避免侦测。

\n

构陷魔通常会避免正面战斗，更偏好以诡计和心理操纵的游戏中戏耍目标。他的特长在于擅长将目标引导上一条曲折的道路，最终令其陷入自我诅咒或自证其罪的末路，迫使对方同意构陷魔的要求。若有潜在的受害者看穿了构陷魔的诡计，他便会承认暂时的失败，在离去后重新编织诡计。当所有诡计都已经失败，必须诉诸武力之时，诱捕魔鬼亦能成为合格的战士，他会利用蛛网般的翅膀和伪装能力抢占先机，运用伏击战术令对手猝不及防。
Insidiator.allSaves: 对抗魔法时所有豁免+1点状态

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法时所有豁免+1点状态 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Chameleon Skin.name: 变色外皮 Chameleon Skin
Chameleon Skin.description: 构陷魔改变皮肤的颜色以适应周遭的环境。这么做甚至可以让他们在缺乏掩蔽的情况下躲藏。当构陷魔移动到不同的环境中时，他必须再次使用该能力，否则将会失去该能力带来的效果。

Change Shape.name: 变身 Change Shape
Change Shape.description:
构陷魔能呈现出任意中型类人生物的外观。这不会改变他的速度或其打击的攻击与伤害的加值，但是可能会改变其打击造成的伤害类型（通常为钝击）。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

Hidden Movement.name: 隐秘行动 Hidden Movement
Hidden Movement.description: 若构陷魔在开始回合时对某个生物处于无踪或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]状态，该生物在对抗构陷魔的攻击时会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]，直至构陷魔的回合结束为止。

Web Trap.name: 蛛网陷阱 Web Trap
Web Trap.description: 被构陷魔的蛛网打击命中的生物会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]，并被黏在最近的表面上，直至它[[/act escape dc=17]]为止。

Nayren Allurajix.name: 奈伦·阿鲁拉吉克 Nayren Allurajix
Nayren Allurajix.allSaves: （对抗区域效果时反射豁免为+19）

+3 Status to Reflex Saves vs. Area Effec.name: 对抗区域效果时反射豁免获得+3点状态加值 +3 Status to Reflex Saves vs. Area Effects

Disillusionment.name: 幻觉破灭 Disillusionment
Disillusionment.description: 每当奈伦成功通过对抗幻术效果的豁免时，她改为获得大成功。

Return to Battle.name: 重返战斗 Return to Battle
Return to Battle.description:
触发 奈伦的生命值降至0或更低

效果 异界裔血脉中的战意仍在奔涌。奈伦自动稳定伤势并获得1点生命值。她站立起身。该移动不会触发反应动作。

Rack the Dissidents.name: 鞭笞异见者 Rack the Dissidents
Rack the Dissidents.description:
频率 每日1次

效果 奈伦的打击使她保持精力充沛，得以继续击倒叛军。持续1分钟或直到她的打击大失败为止；在此期间，每轮第一次，当奈伦成功打击一个生物时，她获得5点临时生命值，持续1轮。

Silence, Heretic!.name: 住口，异端！ Silence, Heretic!
Silence, Heretic!.description: 奈伦进行一次长剑打击。若该攻击命中，目标必须成功通过@Check[fortitude|dc:29]豁免，否则在1轮内无法使用听觉动作。此效果也会阻止目标施放法术，除非是晦匿法术，或是不需要在施放时使用魔法咒语的法术。若大失败，则持续时间改为1分钟。无论豁免结果如何，目标都会在10分钟内对此能力暂时免疫。

Caeto Vulaunex.name: 凯托·乌劳内克斯 Caeto Vulaunex

+2 Status to Will Saves vs. Mental.name: +2 Status to Will Saves vs. Mental

Godclaw Aura.name: Godclaw Aura
Godclaw Aura.description: 15 feet. Followers of any deities on the Godclaw pantheon or of the pantheon itself within the aura immediately know Caeto is a champion of the Godclaw.

Steel Command.name: Steel Command
Steel Command.description:
Trigger A creature in Caeto's aura damages him

Effect Caeto commands his enemy to kneel in supplication. The triggering creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:30] save. They then become immune to Steel Command for 1 minute.

Success The creature must choose to drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} as a free action or take @Damage[3d6[mental],1d8[persistent,spirit]] damage.

Failure The creature must choose to drop prone as a free action and be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} or take @Damage[6d6[mental],2d8[persistent,spirit]] damage.

Critical Failure The creature drops prone, is slowed 1, and takes @Damage[12d6[mental],2d8[persistent,spirit]] damage

Hand of the Avenger.name: Hand of the Avenger
Hand of the Avenger.description: Caeto evokes his oath to bring justice to those he deems a threat to Isger. Until the end of his turn, Caeto can use his lay on hands to damage an enemy in his aura as if they were undead, dealing spirit damage instead of vitality damage.

Lawbreaker's Bane.name: Lawbreaker's Bane
Lawbreaker's Bane.description: Caeto gains a +4 status bonus on damage to Strikes against targets that he knows have broken the law. The bonus increases to +6 if the target is a known member of the Hellbreakers League.

Oppressive Might.name: Oppressive Might
Oppressive Might.description: Caeto uses his posture to assert dominance over the masses. He attempts an Intimidation check to [[/act demoralize]] all non-allied creatures within 60 feet. He doesn't take a penalty against targets who don't understand his language. On a critical success, that target doesn't become temporarily immune to Caeto's other attempts to Demoralize them.

Subdue Fugitive.name: Subdue Fugitive
Subdue Fugitive.description:
Frequency once per minute

Requirements Caeto is wielding his longsword

Effect Caeto uses his shifting rune's Shift Weapon to transform his sword into a flail and makes a melee Strike with it. If the Strike hits and deals damage, he can attempt an Athletics check as a free action to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} the target of the Strike. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward Caeto's multiple attack penalty.

Pacify Fey.name: Pacify Fey
Pacify Fey.description: 40 feet. All creatures with the fey trait who enter or begin their turn in the aura must attempt a @Check[will|dc:26] save. Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature becomes immune to the aura for 1 day. On a failure, the creature can't take hostile actions against the katroome.

Enveloping Web.name: Enveloping Web
Enveloping Web.description: The web of the empress katroome wraps creatures into a cocoon. The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} while it's enveloped in a cocoon ([[/act escape dc=26]]). The web has Hardness 10 and 20 Hit Points. It has resistance 5 to bludgeoning and piercing and weakness 5 to slashing. At the end of the target's turn, if it has yet to Escape from enveloping web, the web grows, increasing the slowed value by 1, to a maximum of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 3}. The katroome can envelop up to three creatures at a time.

Glittering Scales.name: Glittering Scales
Glittering Scales.description:
Frequency once per minute

Effect The katroome flaps its wings of prismatic scales. All creatures within a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] takes @Damage[9d6[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:26|basic] save. On a failure, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 minute, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} on a critical failure.

Pinning Strike.name: Pinning Strike
Pinning Strike.description: The adjutant Hellknight armiger makes a halberd Strike. On a success, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} until the beginning of the adjutant's next turn, until the adjutant moves more than 10 feet away from the target, or the adjutant makes another halberd Strike, whichever comes first. The target can also attempt to [[/act escape dc=18]].

Gliding River Snake.name: Gliding River Snake
Gliding River Snake.publicNotes:
Wise travelers keep watch for snakes along their path, but few expect them to attack from above. When threatened, the gliding river snake takes to high ground and launches toward its target, gliding through the air by flattening its ribs and controlling its flight by moving sinuously. If unable to make an aerial attack, the gliding river snake simply attempts to bite its target and snap off a finger or two. The snake's jaws are extremely powerful, able to bite clean through bone and flesh.

The mildly venomous gliding river snake prefers to keep to itself but reacts harshly to potential threats with a vicious bite. Its mouth is filled with serrated teeth that tear into its prey rather than piercing like a typical snake. Using these teeth, the gliding river snake rends its food into chunks before swallowing, allowing it to target larger prey. Sometimes an unfortunate animal is beset by multiple gliding river snakes, covering it with writhing serpents. These group meals have been mistaken for a singular monster before, as only the snakes' tentacle-like bodies can be seen as they feast.

The gliding river snake often lives in pairs, staying together with its mate through the mating season before separating in the off season. They lay their eggs either in trees or underwater, sometimes even stealing bird nests for their own uses once they've devoured the birds' eggs. Many a birdwatcher has been taken aback by the sight of hatching snakes up in the treetops, occasionally even laid side by side with bird eggs for easy access to a meal.

Deep Breath.name: Deep Breath
Deep Breath.description: The gliding river snake can hold its breath for about an hour.

Aerial Ambush.name: Aerial Ambush
Aerial Ambush.description:
Requirements The gliding river snake is higher than a creature

Effect The gliding river snake launches up to 20 feet down toward a creature and makes a jaws Strike against it. If the snake hits, it doesn't take damage from the fall. If it misses, it takes only half the regular damage from the distance it fell.

Aquatic Ambush.name: Aquatic Ambush
Aquatic Ambush.description:
Requirements The gliding river snake is in water and a creature that hasn't detected it is within 20 feet

Effect The gliding river snake moves up to its swim Speed + 10 feet toward the triggering creature, traveling on water and on land. Once the creature is in reach, the snake makes a jaws Strike against it. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against this Strike.

Weaving Glide.name: Weaving Glide
Weaving Glide.description: The snake glides toward the ground, 5 feet down and up to 20 feet forward through the air. As long as it spends at least 1 action gliding each round and hasn't yet reached the ground, it remains in the air at the end of its turn.

Stumpfield War Saboteurs.name: Stumpfield War Saboteurs
Stumpfield War Saboteurs.publicNotes: Stumpfield's artists enjoy the chaos of creation, which makes them well suited for the parallel chaos of destruction. Isn't sabotage just another form of art? Stumpfield certainly thinks so, and its denizens are happy to use their creative skills to waylay enemies and ambush parties.

Duck, Duck, Loose!.name: Duck, Duck, Loose!
Duck, Duck, Loose!.description:
Trigger The saboteurs are targeted by a Strike or an effect that requires a Reflex save

Effect The saboteurs scramble for the nearest cover. They become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} but gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.other-effects.Item.I9lfZUiCwMiGogVi]{Standard Cover} until the beginning of their next turn.

Rush and Steal.name: Rush and Steal
Rush and Steal.description: Quickly moving in with grasping hands, the Stumpfield war saboteurs take what they can. The saboteurs Stride up to twice their Speed. During this movement, the saboteurs Interact to pick up an unattended object no larger than 2 Bulk or attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} an item from a creature they're adjacent to; the goblins can pick up or Steal as many objects as they have remaining segments in any combination.

Slapstick Traps.name: Slapstick Traps
Slapstick Traps.description:
Requirements The saboteurs' last action was to successfully Hide

Effect The saboteurs laid down falling obstacles as they move unseen. The saboteurs @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} twice. Until the beginning of the saboteurs' next turn, any non-ally creature that moves into a square that the saboteurs snuck through takes @Damage[5d8[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic] save). On a critical failure, the creature also falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. Once this trap has been triggered, the rest of the squares the saboteurs snuck through become difficult terrain until a creature spends 1 hour clearing it.

Slice and Dice!.name: Slice and Dice!
Slice and Dice!.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The saboteurs engage in a coordinated melee attack against each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5], with a @Check[reflex|dc:21|basic|options:area-effect] save. The damage dealt depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[1d8[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage

2 @Damage[(2d8+5)[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage

3 @Damage[(2d8+9)[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage

Falling Crates.name: Falling Crates
Falling Crates.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:17] (trained) to carefully remove the trip wire.
Falling Crates.hazarddescription: A tower of precariously stacked crates is rigged to fall when someone steps through a trip wire.

Tumble Down.name: Tumble Down
Tumble Down.description:
Trigger A creature trips the wire

Effect Several heavy crates come crashing down in the 10-foot square area marked on the map, dealing @Damage[(2d10+10)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage to each creature in that area (@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic] save). A creature who critically fails the save is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Denounce.name: Denounce
Denounce.description:
Lefranek condemns an enemy within 30 feet as a Chelaxian dog and enemy of Isger. Until the start of Lefranek's next turn, any Strikes she or her allies make against the creature do an additional 1d4 precision damage.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.izuJvgHjqI6kQNbK]{Effect: Denounce}

False Flag.name: False Flag
False Flag.description: 60 feet. Lefranek's false flag creates panic and confusion. Hellbreakers in the area take a –1 circumstance penalty to saving throws and DCs vs. effects that give the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} condition. Add 1d8 to the Gala Crowd hazard's check to determine its action during its routine.

Food Fight.name: Food Fight
Food Fight.disable: @Check[occultism|dc:17] (trained) to weaken the spiritual energy in the room, @Check[acrobatics|dc:18] (trained) to pluck a floating plate out of the air, or @Check[intimidation|dc:19] (trained) to reprimand one of the ghostly children for their poor behavior; each successful check disables one of four plates
Food Fight.hazarddescription: Ghostly food appears on cracked plates as they float above the table. The faint outline of children can occasionally be seen as the ectoplasmic food is flung throughout the room.
Food Fight.routine: (4 actions) For each plate disabled or destroyed, the haunt has 1 fewer action. On each action, spectral food is flung off a plate at a different living creature in the room. This ranged Strike doesn't provoke reactions. A creature critically hit by a flung food Strike is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.
Food Fight.reset: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the room or after all four plates are destroyed. After 1 hour, if at least one plate remains, the haunt reactivates. If disabled, the haunt resets after 1 day and the plates magically reassemble. The haunt is permanently destroyed when the attic whisperer in area D5 is destroyed.

Dinner Bell.name: Dinner Bell
Dinner Bell.description:
Trigger A creature moves adjacent to the set table

Effect A loud phantom dinner bell rings before the plates begin to tremble and hover. Each creature in the room takes @Damage[(2d6+2)[sonic]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:17|basic] save). The haunt then rolls initiative.

Captain's Edge.name: Captain's Edge
Captain's Edge.description: Lamperia deals an additional 1d8 precision damage with Strikes when aboard her ship.

Hell's Glare.name: Hell's Glare
Hell's Glare.description: Lamperia's eyes glow like the fires of Hell as she swings her blade. Lamperia makes a rapier Strike. If she hits and deals damage, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical hit).

Cannibalization of the Priestess.name: Cannibalization of the Priestess
Cannibalization of the Priestess.disable: @Check[athletics|dc:28] to push past or run away, or @Check[occultism|dc:28] or @Check[religion|dc:28] (expert) to exorcise the haunt
Cannibalization of the Priestess.hazarddescription: Spectral undead converge on any living creatures to rip into and devour them.
Cannibalization of the Priestess.routine: (1 action) The haunt converges upon all creatures currently bleeding in area M2. The targeted creatures must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic] save against @Damage[3d6[spirit],3d6[void]] damage from the spirits pulling and gnawing on their souls. On a critical failure, the creature also suffers @Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]] damage.
Cannibalization of the Priestess.reset: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after there are no bleeding creatures left in M2. If disabled, it resets after 1 day. Destroying Illcayna is the only way to permanently destroy this haunt.

Swarm.name: Swarm
Swarm.description:
Trigger A living creature enters the square of the town center

Effect All creatures within area M2 take @Damage[3d10[slashing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic] save). The haunt then rolls initiative.

Bravery.name: Bravery
Bravery.description: When Jordis rolls a success on a Will save against a fear effect, they get a critical success instead. Any time they gain the frightened condition, reduce its value by 1.

Shield Warden.name: Shield Warden
Shield Warden.description: When Jordis has their shield raised, they can Shield Block when an attack is made against an adjacent ally. If they do, the shield prevents that ally from taking damage instead of Jordis.

Shielded Advance.name: Shielded Advance
Shielded Advance.description:
Requirements Jordis has their shield raised

Effect Jordis presses forward, using their shield to push back foes. Jordis Strides and Shoves, in either order. The multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, though the Shove does count toward Jordis's multiple attack penalty.

Fiendish Viro Ahala.name: Fiendish Viro Ahala
Fiendish Viro Ahala.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic; +16 Ref vs. area effects

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

+3 Status to Reflex Saves vs. Area Effec.name: +3 Status to Reflex Saves vs. Area Effects

Retributive Glare.name: Retributive Glare
Retributive Glare.description:
Trigger A creature within 60 feet damages Viro

Effect Viro burns the one that hurt them with his gaze. He makes a flaming gaze Strike against the triggering creature. This ranged attack doesn't trigger reactions, and if it's a critical hit, the target also takes @Damage[1d8[persistent,fire]] damage.

Furious Viper Cut.name: Furious Viper Cut
Furious Viper Cut.description:
Requirements Viro's last action was a longsword Strike that dealt damage

Effect The sword transforms into a snake and bites at the target of the required Strike. The target takes @Damage[2d6[poison]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:24|basic] save). On a failure, the target is also racked with terrible pain, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure).

Wrathful Strike.name: Wrathful Strike
Wrathful Strike.description: Viro makes a longsword Strike. This counts as two attacks for his multiple attack penalty. If the Strike hits, it deals an additional die of weapon damage and 1d4 persistent bleed damage.

Punish the Fallen.name: Punish the Fallen
Punish the Fallen.description:
Requirements The Chelaxian recruit's last action was a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} against a foe

Effect The Chelaxian recruit makes a guisarme Strike against the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} foe. This attack is at the same multiple attack penalty as the Trip, but they increase their multiple attack penalty as usual after the Strike has been resolved.

Flurry of Blows.name: Flurry of Blows
Flurry of Blows.description: The novitiate makes two fist Strikes, applying her multiple attack penalty as normal. If both hit the same creature, combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.

Counterspell.name: Counterspell
Counterspell.description:
Trigger A creature Casts a Spell Sephone has prepared

Effect Sephone expends a prepared spell, losing the spell slot as if she had cast the triggering spell. She then attempts to counteract the triggering spell.

Channel Hellfire.name: Channel Hellfire
Channel Hellfire.description:
Frequency three times per day

Effect Sephone fuels her spell with the essence of Hell. The next spell she casts deals fire damage instead of its usual damage type. Any creature that takes damage from the spell and doesn't have the unholy trait also takes an additional @Damage[2d8[spirit]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:25|basic] save).

Drain Religious Symbol.name: Drain Religious Symbol
Drain Religious Symbol.description:
Frequency once per minute

Effect Sephone drains her religious symbol and regains a spell she has cast. During her current turn, she can cast one spell she prepared today and already cast.

Widen Spell.name: Widen Spell
Widen Spell.description: If the next action Sephone uses is to Cast a Spell that has an area of a cone or line and does not have a duration, increase the area of that spell. Add 5 feet to the length of a cone or line that is normally 15 feet long or smaller, and add 10 feet to the length of a larger cone or line.

Warfare Expertise.name: Warfare Expertise
Warfare Expertise.description: Phoebe can use Warfare Lore to Recall Knowledge about most creatures regardless of type, but typically only to determine whether they can be reasoned with, their most notable offensive abilities, and whether one of their saving throws is particularly weak.

Banner Bearer.name: Banner Bearer
Banner Bearer.description: 30 feet. As Phoebe displays the Hellbreakers League banner, all allies in the area gain a +1 status bonus to saves and DCs against devils and Hellknights.

Commander's Orders.name: Commander's Orders
Commander's Orders.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect Phoebe calls out one of the following orders to all her allies in her Hellbreakers League banner aura, letting them immediately take the associated action as a reaction.

  • On Guard! The ally can Raise a Shield, defensively position a weapon with the parry trait, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover}. If the ally isn't benefiting from cover or near a feature that allows them to Take Cover, they can fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} as part of the reaction.
  • Send Them Back to Hell An ally who's flanking a devil, a creature that worships devils, or a creature that has a magical contract with a devil can immediately attempt a Strike.
  • To Me! The ally can Stride but must end their movement in the aura. The ally can Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead of Striding if they have the corresponding movement type.

Sense Heartbond.name: Sense Heartbond
Sense Heartbond.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect Phoebe learns Alceo's present state. She knows his direction and distance, and any conditions affecting him.

Trained Reaction.name: Trained Reaction
Trained Reaction.description:
Requirements Phoebe uses Commander's Orders

Effect Phoebe grants one ally in her Hellbreakers League banner aura an extra reaction that they can use only to follow her Commander's Orders. If they don't use the reaction, it's lost.

Coarti Spy.name: Coarti Spy
Coarti Spy.publicNotes:
The burning-winged coartis are marked by the onerous contracts they agreed to and bound to Hell by the machinations of a legalistic devil, usually a phistophilus. Some coartis are truly a type of fallen celestial, those trapped in horrible agreements for the greater good or due to grievous errors in judgment, but most arise from mortal souls that were on the path to become celestials yet were contractually bound to Hell. Coartis serve in public roles as messengers and personal attendants to demonstrate the power of Hell and the legal acumen of their corruptors.

Celestials universally pity coartis and despise their creators, but their preferred methods of dealing with the corrupted beings differ. While angels argue against lost cases in Pharasma's courts, seeking loopholes in the voluminous contracts, azatas scheme daring heists against the contract storehouses. Archons are the most direct, working to end their blighted lives.

Masters of corruption and architects of conquest, devils seek both to tempt mortal life to join in their pursuit of all things profane and to spread tyranny throughout all worlds. The temptations they offer mortals range from great powers granted by the signing of an infernal contract to twisted favors following a whispered pledge to a diabolic patron, or any number of even subtler exchanges. Those who succumb to these temptations find themselves consigned to an afterlife of endless torment in the pits of Hell, wherein the only hope of escape lies in the chance of being promoted to become a devil in the infernal ranks.

Every devil has a specific role to play in the upkeep of the remorseless bureaucratic machine that is Hell, from soldiers and scholars to inquisitors, lawyers, judges, and executioners. Lowly orts perform subservient labor to more powerful and specialized devils, such as infantry and contract devils, while the greatest nessaris command entire infernal armies.

Asmodeus stands at the apex of the structure he created, but the layers below him are marked by a constant jockeying for position. Most diabolic plans ultimately serve to improve the schemer's place in the hierarchy.
Coarti Spy.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Blood Contract.name: Blood Contract
Blood Contract.description: When the coarti takes damage from their holy weakness, blood flows freely from their eyes and the contract carved into their skin. They take @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] damage and are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} as long as the persistent damage continues, but their Despairing Shriek recharges.

Despairing Shriek.name: Despairing Shriek
Despairing Shriek.description:
The coarti lets out a terrible cry, dealing @Damage[4d6[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:30] with a @Check[will|dc:25|basic|options:area-effect] save. Holy creatures that fail this save are also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}; this added effect has the emotion, fear, and mental traits.

The coarti can't use Despairing Shriek again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Despairing Shriek]]{1d4 rounds}.

Sneak Attack.name: Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description: The coarti spy deals an extra 2d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Wing Snap.name: Wing Snap
Wing Snap.description:
Frequency once per turn

Effect The coarti makes two wing Strikes, then falls if it's flying. It can't Fly until the end of its turn.

Stair Spikes.name: Stair Spikes
Stair Spikes.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:22] (trained) to unhook the pressure plate or @Check[crafting|dc:24] (trained) to block the spikes
Stair Spikes.hazarddescription: A set of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} spikes stabs into the feet of anyone on the landing or front stairs.

Look Sharp.name: Look Sharp
Look Sharp.description:
Trigger The door is opened while someone is standing on the stairs

Effect Spikes fire upward, dealing @Damage[(2d8+5)[piercing]] damage to all creatures standing on the landing or stairs (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save). On a failure, the creature takes a –5 status penalty to its Speed for 1 hour; on a critical failure it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}.

Warshard Wight.name: Warshard Wight
Warshard Wight.publicNotes:
Wights are intelligent undead spawned through inescapable cycles of spite. This spite might come from their own malevolent will in life, or can be instilled by necromantic rituals, typically involving the desecration of burial sites. Wights usually haunt burial grounds, catacombs, or other places of the dead. Their hunger is targeted toward the living—those whose pumping hearts and ruddy warmth inspire visceral hatred.

As many types of wights exist as types of people from which they might be created. Hulking brutes, skittering sneaks, and cunning tinkers all make for different wights with different niches to fill. The environment, too, plays a part in determining a wight's special abilities and defenses. Frost wights, for instance, can be found in parts of the world where exposure is a common end and the resentment of being left alone in the wild is a common source of spite. Durable and sustained by void energy, wights can last in harsh environments without decaying the way some lesser undead do.

A single wight can wreak significant havoc if it is compelled to rise from its tomb. Because creatures slain under a wight's curse can become wights as well, all it takes is a single wight and a handful of unlucky graveyard visitors to create a veritable horde of these undead. Thus, canny priests and adventurers know that the best solution to a wight problem is swift and total eradication. Care must be taken, though, to destroy wight spawn before attempting to destroy the parent wight, for spawn without a master gain the ability to create spawn of their own.

Urgathoa's Weapon.name: Urgathoa's Weapon
Urgathoa's Weapon.description: The warshard wight has a scythe arm resembling a Child of Urgathoa.

Final Spite.name: Final Spite
Final Spite.description:
Trigger The warshward wight is reduced to 0 Hit Points

Effect The warshard wight makes a Strike before being destroyed. It doesn't gain any temporary Hit Points from drain life on this Strike.

Bloody Wail.name: Bloody Wail
Bloody Wail.description:
The warshard wight cries out in an unearthly shriek. Living creatures within 50 feet must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:23] save. The warshard wight can't make another bloody wail for [[/br 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Success The creature bleeds from their ears and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The creature bleeds from their ears and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature takes a –2 status penalty to saving throws against drain life.

Drain Life.name: Drain Life
Drain Life.description:
When the warshard wight damages a living creature with a melee Strike using an unarmed attack or its bound weapon, the warshard wight gains 5 temporary Hit Points and the creature must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:20|options:inflicts:drained] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}. Further damage dealt by the warshard wight increases the drained condition value by 1 on a failed save, to a maximum of drained 4.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.LRIYUFQ7FE9H4RWD]{Effect: Drain Life}

Warshard Wight Spawn.name: Warshard Wight Spawn
Warshard Wight Spawn.description: A living humanoid slain by a warshard wight's scything blade or claw Strike rises as a spawned wight after [[/br 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}. This spawned wight is under the command of the warshard wight that killed it. It doesn't have drain life or warshard wight spawn and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} for as long as it's a spawned wight. If its creator dies, the spawned wight becomes a full-fledged, autonomous warshard wight; it regains its free will, gains drain life and warshard wight spawn, and is no longer clumsy.

Spore Spears.name: Spore Spears
Spore Spears.disable: @Check[nature|dc:17] or @Check[occultism|dc:17] twice to cut off the unstable connection to the Plane of Wood, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (2nd rank; counteract DC 16) to counteract the planar magic
Spore Spears.hazarddescription: A large patch of moss ripples like the surface of a pond as spears of green plant matter jut outward.
Spore Spears.routine: (2 actions) For each action, the moss pond makes a spore spear Strike against a random non-plant creature on or within 10 feet of the moss pond.
Spore Spears.reset: If the trap isn't disabled, it becomes dormant for 10 minutes if there are no creatures on or within 10 feet of the moss patch at the start of its turn.

Planar Ripple.name: Planar Ripple
Planar Ripple.description:
Trigger Two or more non-plant creatures step onto the moss pond

Effect The moss pond ripples oddly as its connection to the Plane of Wood intensifies. Each creature on the pond must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:17|options:area-effect,damaging-effect,inflicts:prone] save or be knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. A creature who critically fails the save also takes @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage from the fall. The pond then rolls initiative.

Odvolos.name: Odvolos
Odvolos.publicNotes: As empires posture amid decline and demagogues preside over republics, censorship devils scatter the burning ash of ignorance as a comforting veil over the complications of history and causality. These devils are feverishly devoted to Hell and find anything that could be interpreted against Hell's doctrines to be anathema and deserving of immediate destruction. Inconvenient accounts of the past, truths that draw the faithful away from the ways of Asmodeus, words that bring hope to those who might otherwise fall into a devil's temptations—these are fuel for the odvolos's hateful torches, burning bright on the cinders of ink and vellum.
Odvolos.allSaves: +1 status to all save vs. magic, -1 to all saves vs. emotion effects

Fevered Consciousness.name: Fevered Consciousness
Fevered Consciousness.description: An odvolos ignores @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealment} or penalties to Perception from ash, fire, and smoke.

-1 Status to All Saves vs. Emotion Effec.name: -1 Status to All Saves vs. Emotion Effects

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Purge Records.name: Purge Records
Purge Records.description:
Trigger A creature the odvolos can see or hear within 15 feet Casts a Spell from a scroll or Activates a grimoire

Effect The odvolos Steps toward the creature and makes a longspear Strike. If the attack is a critical hit, the triggering action is disrupted.

Shroud of Burning Pages.name: Shroud of Burning Pages
Shroud of Burning Pages.description: 15 feet. The odvolos is surrounded by an aura of burning paper and scorched parchment, which provides @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealment} as if it was smoke. A creature within the aura takes a –2 circumstance penalty to Perception checks, and a creature that ends its turn in the aura must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:22|options:area-effect] save or any items with written information held or carried by the creature takes @Damage[1d4[persistent,fire]] damage. Magical items and religious texts are immune to this effect.

Pyre's Mercy.name: Pyre's Mercy
Pyre's Mercy.description:
The odvolos attempts to [[/act demoralize]] a creature within 30 feet. If the odvolos succeeds, the creature also gains fire weakness 5 while frightened.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.u3Qy9t7RuE4wKV0O]{Effect: Pyre's Mercy}

Torchbearer.name: Torchbearer
Torchbearer.description: Piercing weapons wielded by an odvolos gain the magical trait and deal an additional 1d4 fire damage on a successful Strike and 1d8 persistent fire damage on a critical hit.

Drunken Stumble.name: Drunken Stumble
Drunken Stumble.description:
Trigger The drunken Isgeri Slayer is hit with an attack that deals physical damage

Effect The drunken slayer stumbles away from the blow. They gain resistance 2 to the damage of the triggering attack and they can Step. They also take a –1 circumstance penalty to AC for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.QVLX06QevxTcuZxU]{Effect: Drunken Stumble}

Hunt Prey.name: Hunt Prey
Hunt Prey.description:
The Isgeri Slayer designates a single creature they can see and hear, or one they're Tracking, as their prey.

The slayer gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to [[/act seek]] the prey and to Survival checks to [[/act track]] the prey.

The first time the slayer hits the designated prey in a round, they deal an additional 1d6 precision damage. The slayer also ignores the penalty for making ranged attacks within their second range increment. These effects last until the poacher uses Hunt Prey again.

Denounce Heretic.name: Denounce Heretic
Denounce Heretic.description:
Trigger A creature within 60 feet who the deathless acolyte can see and who doesn't worship Urgathoa casts a divine spell

Effect The deathless acolyte attempts to counteract the triggering spell using their spell attack modifier and a counteract rank of 2. If the deathless acolyte fails to counteract the spell, the caster is temporarily immune to further uses of Denounce Heretic for 24 hours.

Field of Undeath.name: Field of Undeath
Field of Undeath.description: 20 feet. Allies within the aura who have void healing gain fast healing 2. When a creature within the aura would receive vitality healing, it must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] or receive no healing from the effect.

Draconic Fumecrux.name: Draconic Fumecrux
Draconic Fumecrux.publicNotes:
This creature is the result of the fumecrux ritual performed on the head of a young adamantine dragon. Unlike most fumecruxes, draconic fumecruxes retain some of the unique magic of their living counterparts.

By studying the phenomena of hellcrowns and beheaded, Chelaxian mages have created a fusion of the two. Years of experimentation culminated in the creation of fumecruxes, brimstone specters capped with the decapitated and rotting heads of great beasts. The process is being attempted more frequently as yet another weapon for the war against Andoran.

Desiccated Boulder Breath.name: Desiccated Boulder Breath
Desiccated Boulder Breath.description:
The draconic fumecrux belches forth a mass of stones that are partially solid and partially void energy. These stones deal @Damage[4d8[bludgeoning],4d8[void]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save).

It can't use Desiccated Boulder Breath again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Desiccated Boulder Breath]]{1d4 rounds}.

Hellfume Body.name: Hellfume Body
Hellfume Body.description: A fumecrux's body consists of hellish fumes infused with void energy. When a creature that's holding its breath while it has been Swallowed Whole by a fumecrux attacks or casts a spell on a turn, the creature loses 3 rounds of air instead of 2.

Spit Up.name: Spit Up
Spit Up.description:
Requirements The draconic fumecrux has a creature Swallowed Whole

Effect The draconic fumecrux spits out the swallowed creature, flinging it through the air up to 40 feet away. The creature takes bludgeoning damage equal to the distance it traveled and lands @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. If it lands in the same space as another creature, the other creature is pushed 5 feet and takes @Damage[(3d8+4)[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save). The fumecrux can't Spit Up more than one creature at a time no matter their size, and the most recently swallowed creature is Spit Up first.

Blinding Spray.name: Blinding Spray
Blinding Spray.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:20] (trained) to disable the blade that bursts the bladder
Blinding Spray.hazarddescription: A bladder of powdered peppers is secreted in a compartment above the door.

No Orphans Allowed.name: No Orphans Allowed
No Orphans Allowed.description:
Trigger The door is opened

Effect The powder sprays in a burst that fills the square in front of the door and all adjacent squares in the orphans' dormitory. Any creature in the area must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:21] save.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is blinded for 1 minute.

Elite Ort.name: Elite Ort
Elite Ort.publicNotes:
These shapeless masses of quivering flesh are the least of devilkind. Pathetic creatures from Hell's first layer, orts roam alongside damned and suffering souls. Nessaris can combine the essence of a mob of orts to concentrate their collective wickedness within a single form, granting it an infernal sentience and transforming it into a more powerful devil (see the nessari's Shape Devils ability).

Masters of corruption and architects of conquest, devils seek both to tempt mortal life to join in their pursuit of all things profane and to spread tyranny throughout all worlds. The temptations they offer mortals range from great powers granted by the signing of an infernal contract to twisted favors following a whispered pledge to a diabolic patron, or any number of even subtler exchanges. Those who succumb to these temptations find themselves consigned to an afterlife of endless torment in the pits of Hell, wherein the only hope of escape lies in the chance of being promoted to become a devil in the infernal ranks.

Every devil has a specific role to play in the upkeep of the remorseless bureaucratic machine that is Hell, from soldiers and scholars to inquisitors, lawyers, judges, and executioners. Lowly orts perform subservient labor to more powerful and specialized devils, such as infantry and contract devils, while the greatest nessaris command entire infernal armies.

Asmodeus stands at the apex of the structure he created, but the layers below him are marked by a constant jockeying for position. Most diabolic plans ultimately serve to improve the schemer's place in the hierarchy.

Fiendish Order.name: Fiendish Order
Fiendish Order.description: 30 feet. An elite ort is ripe enough to be shaped into another, more powerful devil and gives off an aura of superiority. Each allied ort in the aura gains a +1 circumstance bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Subservience.name: Subservience
Subservience.description:
Orts have little drive of their own, but other devils can take command of them. A non-ort devil can issue a command to all orts within 60 feet of it with a single action, which has the auditory and concentrate traits. The devil picks one of the following orders orts can understand, and the orts follow that order. The command and its effects end once the commander is out of the ort's sight, when a new command is issued by the same or another devil, or when the ort dies.

  • Kill The ort attacks one target the commander singles out and gains a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls against the target.
  • Defend The ort circles the commander and attacks any creature that comes near. It gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saves.
  • Fetch The ort gains a +10–foot circumstance bonus to its Speed and attempts to get an object or person the commander singles out. It attacks anyone and anything that gets in the way.
  • Work The ort performs drudge work dictated by the commander.

Slashing Rune.name: Slashing Rune
Slashing Rune.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:25] (trained) to silently erase the rune, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (3rd rank; counteract DC 22) to counteract the rune
Slashing Rune.hazarddescription: An invisible rune creates knives of force if someone tries to bypass the lock.

Slash.name: Slash
Slash.description:
Trigger A creature attempts a Thievery check to Pick the Lock

Effect Knives of force deal @Damage[(4d8+18)[slashing]] damage to the triggering creature (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save). On a failure, the creature also takes a –1 penalty to Dex-based skills for 1 hour.

Disarming Dummy.name: Disarming Dummy
Disarming Dummy.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:18] (trained) to jam the rotor or @Check[athletics|dc:25] to knock the dummy over
Disarming Dummy.hazarddescription: A leather strap on the dummy's mechanical arm swings around, knocking items out the hands of anyone adjacent.

Hold On!.name: Hold On!
Hold On!.description:
Trigger A creature moves adjacent to the trap

Effect The trap makes a single Athletics check with a +17 modifier to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} the creature.

Bite of the Asp Stance.name: Bite of the Asp Stance
Bite of the Asp Stance.description:
Requirements Sister Endreah is wielding an asp coil

Effect Sister Endreah is an expert at using her sword in close quarters. Her asp coil loses the reach weapon property, but she can make asp coil Strikes instead of fist Strikes when she uses Flurry of Blows. Claw of pain also applies to these asp coil Strikes when in this stance.

Claw of Pain.name: Claw of Pain
Claw of Pain.description: When Sister Endreah targets the same creature with two Strikes from her Flurry of Blows, she can cause lingering pain. If either Strike hits and deals damage, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:21] save or take @Damage[1d4[persistent,mental]] damage (and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} on a critical failure).

Flurry of Blows.name: Flurry of Blows
Flurry of Blows.description: Sister Endreah makes two fist Strikes, applying her multiple attack penalty as normal. If both hit the same creature, combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.

Illcayna Alonnor.name: Illcayna Alonnor
Illcayna Alonnor.allSaves: +1 status bonus to all saves vs. holy effects

Bleeding Heart of Urgathoa.name: Bleeding Heart of Urgathoa
Bleeding Heart of Urgathoa.description: Red ichor drips from the heart-shaped warshard embedded in Illcayna's chest. This warshard functions as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Wtm4JdxeTLQi3zQI]{Symbol of Conflict (Greater)}, except it's attuned only to Urgathoa. As long as Illcayna exists, non-Urgathoans can't use the warshard even if it's removed. If Illcayna dies, the warshard acts as a regular greater symbol of conflict.

Reaper's Sigh.name: Reaper's Sigh
Reaper's Sigh.description: Illcayna is fused with Reaper's Sigh, granting her a +4 circumstance bonus to her Reflex DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} the scythe. This bonus is reduced to +2 for 1 round after she's critically hit with a slashing weapon.

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Holy Effects.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Holy Effects

Field of Unholy Undeath.name: Field of Unholy Undeath
Field of Unholy Undeath.description: 40 feet. Undead allies within the aura gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and saving throws. If the ally has void healing, they also gain fast healing 5. A living creature who doesn't worship Urgathoa takes @Damage[6d6[void]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:26|basic] save) when they enter or start their turn in the aura. Regardless of the result of the saving throw, that creature becomes temporarily immune to the aura for 1 day.

Life to Unlife.name: Life to Unlife
Life to Unlife.description:
Frequency once per minute

Trigger A creature within 30 feet that Illcayna can observe Casts a divine Spell with the healing trait

Effect Illcayna sadistically twists the healing magic against the living. She expends a prepared spell of the same rank as the triggering spell and then attempts to counteract the triggering spell using Religion. If she successfully counteracts the spell, Illcayna consumes the magic and regurgitates it as a 3-action harm spell of the rank of the countered spell.

Share Blessings.name: Share Blessings
Share Blessings.description: When Illcayna is destroyed, she explodes in a blast of infectious rot. All creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] are exposed to pallid plague.

Pallid Plague.name: Pallid Plague
Pallid Plague.description:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:27]

Stage 1 carrier (3 days)

Stage 2 @Damage[3d8[void]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} (1 day)

Stage 3 @Damage[3d8[void]] damage, doomed 1, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (1 day)

Stage 4 @Damage[4d8[void]] damage, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 2}, and drained 1 (1 day)

Stage 5 @Damage[4d8[void]] damage, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 3}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} (1 day)

Stage 6 dead.

A creature that dies while infected with pallid plague rises as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.DBTbqI9QQRtlJwWh]{Wight}.

Reap.name: Reap
Reap.description: Illcayna makes a Reaper's Sigh Strike and compares the attack roll result to the ACs of two foes who must both be within her melee reach. Roll damage only once, and apply it to each creature hit. Reap counts as two attacks for Illcayna's multiple attack penalty.

Wake the Dead.name: Wake the Dead
Wake the Dead.description:
Frequency once per minute

Requirements Illcayna is adjacent to a creature that died within the last minute

Effect Illcayna animates the dead with a touch of her hand. The creature must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:29] save or arise as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.DBTbqI9QQRtlJwWh]{Wight}. These wights automatically become loyal to Illcayna and independently act in her interest and follow her command until destroyed.

Hestlebeth.name: Hestlebeth
Hestlebeth.publicNotes:
A jailer's primary responsibility is to keep prisoners from escaping. Jailers must often use force, or the threat of force, to keep their charges in line, as even the most carefully crafted cells, manacles, or chains can fail with time and persistence when the prisoners have the will to attempt an escape.

Larger societies rely on those with the authority and the ability to interpret and enforce laws. Some carry out these duties fairly, but others are harsh and cruel, imposing severe punishments on anyone unable to pay for clemency.

+1 Bonus on Perception to Find Concealed.name: +1 Bonus on Perception to Find Concealed Objects

Efficient Capture.name: Efficient Capture
Efficient Capture.description:
Requirements The jailer has manacles in hand and is adjacent to a creature

Effect The jailer attempts to bind the creature's wrists or ankles with the manacles. If the jailer succeeds at an attack roll with a @Check[efficient-capture|against:ac]{+9} modifier against the target's AC, they apply the manacles.

Hunter's Fatigue.name: Hunter's Fatigue
Hunter's Fatigue.description: Having fought undead nonstop for the entire day, both Hellknights have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} condition. The condition goes away as usual with a full night's rest.

Intimidating Strike.name: Intimidating Strike
Intimidating Strike.description: The jailer makes a melee Strike. If it hits and deals damage, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical hit.

Subdue Prisoners.name: Subdue Prisoners
Subdue Prisoners.description: The jailer doesn't take the normal penalty for making a nonlethal attack when attacking with their club.

Skeletal Hellknight Bonesinger.name: Skeletal Hellknight Bonesinger
Skeletal Hellknight Bonesinger.publicNotes:
Some undead Hellknights can command the bones of both their own bodies and others, and they primarily use this ability to temporarily strengthen themselves and summon waves of reinforcements. While just as undead as their compatriots, these so-called bonesingers have enough intelligence to join their living counterparts, though they're generally shunned and disavowed.

The bodies of Hellknights occasionally rise to continue their fight. This is just one example of an undead soldier of Hell.

Call to Arms.name: Call to Arms
Call to Arms.description: The skeletal Hellknight bonesinger strikes its rib cage three times, creating a loud, ominous clatter. All mindless skeletons in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] must use their reaction to Stride closer to the bonesinger.

For the Cause.name: For the Cause
For the Cause.description:
Frequency once per day

Requirements The skeletal Hellknight bonesinger has fewer than half their Hit Points remaining

Effect The bonesinger reaches out through the necromantic magic that animates the dead around them and pulls it into themself. The bonesinger chooses up to three mindless skeletons with the minion trait that they control within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] and destroys them. The bonesinger regains @Damage[2d6[healing,void]|shortLabel] Hit Points for each skeleton destroyed.

Invoke Reckoning.name: Invoke Reckoning
Invoke Reckoning.description:
Frequency once per round

Requirements The skeletal Hellknight bonesinger's last action was to damage an enemy with a melee Strike

Effect The bonesinger pulls at the bones of the creature they just damaged, releasing a pulse of void energy. That creature takes @Damage[4d8[void]] damage and must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:23] save.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Umok Beastspeaker Circle.name: Umok Beastspeaker Circle
Umok Beastspeaker Circle.publicNotes:
The gnomes of Umok have a reticence to fire after the pyrrhic wildfire that razed the Chitterwood during the Goblinblood Wars. To help protect their home from unwanted arson, many gnomes of Umok have learned to communicate with animals, whose instincts can quickly sniff out unauthorized smoke or flame. The two groups work together to keep the town safe, with the animals serving as an early-warning system when threats approach.

Several Umok beastspeakers have joined the war effort, harnessing their primal magic and their connection with animals against the armies of Cheliax. Their powerful magics are used to summon beasts of the wild to defend Isger from forces that threaten the peace of their home, pitting primal power against fiends.

Animal Empathy.name: Animal Empathy
Animal Empathy.description: The beastspeaker circle can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals.

Muster Animals.name: Muster Animals
Muster Animals.description: The beastspeakers summon a group of wild animals to attack all creatures in a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] within 60 feet. The animals deal @Damage[3d8[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic] save). When the beastspeaker circle is reduced to 2 segments, this area decreases to a @Template[type:burst|distance:5].

Staff Assault.name: Staff Assault
Staff Assault.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The beastspeakers grip their staves with two hands and attack all enemies in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5], with a @Check[reflex|dc:22|basic] save. The amount of damage depends on the number of actions used.

1 @Damage[(1d8+1)[bludgeoning]] damage

2 @Damage[(2d8+6)[bludgeoning]] damage

3 @Damage[(2d8+10)[bludgeoning]] damage

Troop Spellcasting.name: Troop Spellcasting
Troop Spellcasting.description: When the beastspeaker circle Casts a Spell, the individual members combine their efforts into casting a more powerful version than any one member could achieve alone. When Casting a Spell that has an area of a burst, cone, or line and doesn't have a duration, increase the area of that spell. Add 5 feet to the radius of a burst that normally has a radius of at least 10 feet (a burst with a smaller radius is not affected). Add 5 feet to the length of a cone or line that is normally 15 feet long or smaller, and add 10 feet to the length of a larger cone or line.

Play Time.name: Play Time
Play Time.disable: @Check[occultism|dc:19] (trained) to exorcise the spirits of the toy box, @Check[athletics|dc:20] (trained) to hold the toy box closed momentarily, or @Check[diplomacy|dc:21] (trained) to convince the spirits that play time is over; three total success are required to disable the haunt
Play Time.hazarddescription: An old, dusty toy box creaks open and forcefully expels a series of cracked and broken toys.
Play Time.routine: (1 action) The toy box belches forth a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] of toys, dealing 3d8 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage (chosen randomly each time) with a @Check[reflex|dc:20|basic] save.
Play Time.reset: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the room or if the toy box is destroyed. After 1 hour, if the toy box remains, the haunt reactivates. If disabled, the haunt resets after 1 day. The haunt is permanently destroyed when the attic whisperer in area D5 is destroyed.

Terrifying Toy Box.name: Terrifying Toy Box
Terrifying Toy Box.description:
Trigger A creature approaches within 10 feet of the toy box

Effect The toy box lid slowly opens with a groan, revealing a yawning chasm into nothingness. Each creature who can see the toy box must attempt a @Check[will|dc:23] save. The haunt then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and can't reduce its frightened condition below 1 while the haunt is active.

Critical Failure As failure, but @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}.

Swiftrun Clergy.name: Swiftrun Clergy
Swiftrun Clergy.publicNotes:
Swiftrun is a small settlement dedicated to Erastil, barely large enough to be considered a village. Its priests are devoted to community and peace, nature and nurture. And yet, sometimes the time comes when one must take up arms to protect their community, when words and gentleness aren't enough.

The Erastilian clergy is known more for their farming techniques than their magic, but their rural ways shouldn't fool anyone into thinking they can't defend themselves. Each priest is equipped with the divine power of Old Deadeye as well as sharpshooting skills conducive to Erastil's favored weapon, the longbow. These priests are prepared to defend their homes with their skills when they must, though they are never eager to shed blood and would rather spend their days tending their crops and community.

Longbow Volley.name: Longbow Volley
Longbow Volley.description: The Swiftrun clergy draw their longbows, then launch a ranged attack in the form of a volley. This volley is a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] within 60 feet that deals @Damage[3d6[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:21|basic|options:area-effect] save. When the regiment is reduced to 2 segments, this area decreases to a @Template[type:burst|distance:5].

Swift Daggers.name: Swift Daggers
Swift Daggers.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect Swiftrun's clergy swiftly strike with their daggers against each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5], with a @Check[reflex|dc:21|basic|options:area-effect] save. The damage dealt depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[(1d4+1)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

2 @Damage[(2d4+7)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

3 @Damage[(2d4+10)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

Troop Spellcasting.name: Troop Spellcasting
Troop Spellcasting.description: When the Swiftrun clergy Casts a Spell, their constituent members combine their efforts into casting a more powerful version of the spell than any one member could achieve alone. When Casting a Spell that has an area of a burst, cone, or line and doesn't have a duration, increase the area of that spell. Add 5 feet to the radius of a burst that normally has a radius of at least 10 feet (a burst with a smaller radius is not affected). Add 5 feet to the length of a cone or line that is normally 15 feet long or smaller, and add 10 feet to the length of a larger cone or line.

Stumpfield War Chanter Choir.name: 树桩地战歌合唱团 Stumpfield War Chanter Choir
Stumpfield War Chanter Choir.publicNotes: 就像大多数地精一样，树桩地的地精艺术家也热爱好听的歌曲。尽管他们完全算不上是战士，但这些地精也已经拿起屠狗刀，要为依斯嘉的解放而战。不过，在尖兵作战遭遇中，他们作为部队资产的主要优势是能够用战歌鼓舞盟友和扰乱敌人。

In Our Wake, Hell Will Break!.name: 我们觉醒，地狱将破！ In Our Wake, Hell Will Break!
In Our Wake, Hell Will Break!.description: 30尺。战歌合唱团不断地歌唱和鼓劲来激励他们的破狱者盟友。灵光内的每个盟友生物会在对抗心灵效果的豁免检定中获得+1点环境加值。

Goblins Slice and Goblins Dice!.name: 地精切片又切块！ Goblins Slice and Goblins Dice!
Goblins Slice and Goblins Dice!.description:
1至3

频率 1次/轮

效果 战歌合唱团挥舞屠狗刀，攻击@Template[type:emanation|distance:5]内的每个敌人，这具有@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic]豁免。造成的伤害取决于动作数量。

1 @Damage[(1d6+2)[slashing]]伤害

2 @Damage[(2d6+8)[slashing]]伤害

3 @Damage[(3d6+11)[slashing]]伤害

Hark! The Goblins Chanters Sing!.name: 听！地精歌者唱！ Hark! The Goblins Chanters Sing!
Hark! The Goblins Chanters Sing!.description: 战歌合唱团突然唱起一首熟悉的歌曲，但旋律却很陌生。位于30尺内、数量等同于部队当前剩余部分数值的敌人必须尝试@Check[will|dc:25]豁免。无论结果如何，目标都会在1分钟内临时免疫该能力。失败的目标会因为被战歌合唱团的韵律分散注意力而陷入持续1轮的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 1}（大失败时为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 2}）。

Sarcovalt Swarm.name: Sarcovalt Swarm
Sarcovalt Swarm.publicNotes:
In most cases, it's very unlikely that one will come across a sarcovalt on their own. More likely, a swarm of Urgathoa's disgusting creations will be beset upon an unfortunate village, the creatures just clever enough to duck away from the best attempts to kill them.

There are few creatures throughout the multiverse more bizarrely revolting than the sarcovalt, a fiend with the body of a fly and the head of a fleshless vulture skull. While a creature barely 2 feet long might not seem threatening, sarcovalt swarms can overwhelm entire villages. Sarcovalts' heads almost seem to be wholly separate entities from their bodies and will vomit up whatever they capture in their beaks hours later as putrid, coagulated sludge.
Sarcovalt Swarm.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. death effects

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Death Effects.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Death Effects

Aura of Blight.name: Aura of Blight
Aura of Blight.description:
15 feet. The sarcovalt is surrounded by a miasma of infection. An enemy that enters or ends their turn in the aura must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:25] save.

Success The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to the aura for 1 minute.

Failure Until the end of its next turn, the creature takes a –1 circumstance penalty to saves against disease effects.

Critical Failure Until the end of its next turn, the creature takes a –2 circumstance bonus against disease effects and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}.

Droning Waste.name: Droning Waste
Droning Waste.description: The buzzing of the swarm's wings hit an unholy pitch, making those who hear it feel dizzy and lightheaded. Each creature within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] must attempt a @Check[will|dc:27] save. On a failure, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} and takes a –1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls until the start of its next turn (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} on a critical failure).

Heads Will Roll.name: Heads Will Roll
Heads Will Roll.description: The swarm detaches its heads from its bodies and rains them down on its enemies in a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] radius within 30 feet. Each head deals falling damage, as if falling from 20 feet up, on any creature it lands on and otherwise takes the damage itself. If a head has a creature within its reach after it falls, it attempts to bite that creature. If any of these bites are critical successes, the head can immediately attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} the creature.

Swarming Bites.name: Swarming Bites
Swarming Bites.description: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes @Damage[4d6[piercing],2d4[persistent,bleed]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:27|basic] save).

Gredress Tilnanos.name: Gredress Tilnanos
Gredress Tilnanos.publicNotes:
Demonologists can pull a creature from the Outer Rifts and bend it to their will... for a time.

Hidden secrets and occult powers have an irresistible lure for many. Since the majority of these NPCs are spellcasters, consider using alternative spell lists to adjust their themes.

Diabolic Certitude.name: Diabolic Certitude
Diabolic Certitude.description:
Some signifers are so assured of their power to control devils that they sometimes reach too far. When Gredress publicly espouses the superiority of Hell, she gains a +1 status bonus to skill checks, AC, and saves for 1 day. These bonuses don't apply against devils. At the end of the day, Gredress must attempt a @Check[will|dc:20] save or take a –1 status penalty to skill checks, AC, and saves against devils for 1 day (or –2 on a critical failure).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.6bGS19fnwbv4E7mn]{Effect: Diabolic Certitude}

Breach the Pit.name: Breach the Pit
Breach the Pit.description:
Requirements Gredress's last action was to cast a non-cantrip spell

Effect Gredress siphons energy drawn from Hell into her weapon. Until the end of the turn, the weapon deals an extra 2d6 damage.

Roll 1d20 to determine the type:

1–4 cold

5–12 fire

13–16 poison

17–20 void.

Devil Summoning.name: Devil Summoning
Devil Summoning.description: Gredress can cast a 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.29ytKctjg7qSW2ff]{Summon Fiend} arcane spell to summon a devil. To do so, she must sacrifice two 4th-rank prepared spells and voluntarily take @Damage[4d12[mental]] damage that can't be reduced or prevented. If Gredress is unable to Sustain the Spell, including if she's knocked out or killed, the spell continues, but the GM rolls a @Check[flat|dc:10] each round, ending the spell on a failure.

Erinys Sister Wight.name: Erinys Sister Wight
Erinys Sister Wight.publicNotes:
Wights are intelligent undead spawned through inescapable cycles of spite. This spite might come from their own malevolent will in life, or can be instilled by necromantic rituals, typically involving the desecration of burial sites. Wights usually haunt burial grounds, catacombs, or other places of the dead. Their hunger is targeted toward the living—those whose pumping hearts and ruddy warmth inspire visceral hatred.

As many types of wights exist as types of people from which they might be created. Hulking brutes, skittering sneaks, and cunning tinkers all make for different wights with different niches to fill. The environment, too, plays a part in determining a wight's special abilities and defenses. Frost wights, for instance, can be found in parts of the world where exposure is a common end and the resentment of being left alone in the wild is a common source of spite. Durable and sustained by void energy, wights can last in harsh environments without decaying the way some lesser undead do.

A single wight can wreak significant havoc if it is compelled to rise from its tomb. Because creatures slain under a wight's curse can become wights as well, all it takes is a single wight and a handful of unlucky graveyard visitors to create a veritable horde of these undead. Thus, canny priests and adventurers know that the best solution to a wight problem is swift and total eradication. Care must be taken, though, to destroy wight spawn before attempting to destroy the parent wight, for spawn without a master gain the ability to create spawn of their own.

Grave Weapon.name: Grave Weapon
Grave Weapon.description: The wight is bound to the darts she was buried with.

Final Spite.name: Final Spite
Final Spite.description:
Trigger The wight is reduced to 0 Hit Points

Effect The wight makes a Strike before being destroyed. This Strike can inflict corrupting spite, but fueled by spite doesn't apply.

Fueled by Spite.name: Fueled by Spite
Fueled by Spite.description: Each time a creature loses Hit Points due to a corrupting spite curse the wight inflicted, the wight gains 3 temporary Hit Points.

Claw of Pain.name: Claw of Pain
Claw of Pain.description: When the sister wight targets the same creature with two Strikes from her Flurry of Blows, she can cause lingering pain. If either Strike hits and deals damage, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:18] save or take @Damage[1d4[persistent,mental]] damage (and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} on a critical failure).

Corrupting Spite.name: Corrupting Spite
Corrupting Spite.description:
The wight's unarmed attacks and bound weapons inflict a curse that makes a creature grow weak and spiteful. If a wight inflicts corrupting spite on a creature already afflicted by it, the victim attempts a new save, ignoring the result if it's better than a failure.

A living humanoid that dies while under the curse rises as a wight after [[/gmr 1d4 #Wight Spawn Timer]]{1d4 rounds}, controlled by the wight that killed it. The wight spawn can't inflict corrupting spite and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}. If its creator dies or after roughly a month of existence, the new wight becomes autonomous and turns into a normal wight

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:17];

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and doesn't treat any creatures as allies (1 round)

Stage 3 As stage 2, except @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3} (1 round)

Stage 4 As stage 2, except @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 4} (1 round).

Flurry of Blows.name: Flurry of Blows
Flurry of Blows.description: The sister wight makes two fist Strikes, applying her multiple attack penalty as normal. If both hit the same creature, combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.

Aurocan.name: Aurocan
Aurocan.publicNotes:
One can predict what foes are on the battlefield by how they sound. Foot soldiers clang weapons on shields as they march. Cavalry is marked by a rapid drumbeat of hooves. Armies with great monsters under their command don't try to silence their hair-raising screeches.

No sound prompts as much caution as the steady clicking of gears and hiss of billowing steam, for the only thing that accompanies that chorus is an aurocan: a mechanical creature created in the shape of a massive six-legged bull prone to exploding when destroyed. The aurocan's greatest strength is how its head can detach from its body to rain down scalding steam from above.

Wind-Up.name: Wind-Up
Wind-Up.description:
24 hours, [[/act disable-device dc=24]], standby

For a clockwork to act, it must be wound with a unique key by another creature. This takes 1 minute. Once wound, it remains operational for the listed amount of time, usually 24 hours, after which time it becomes unaware of its surroundings and can't act until it's wound again. Some clockworks' abilities require them to spend some of their remaining operational time. They can't spend more than they have and shut down immediately once they have 0 time remaining. If it's unclear when a clockwork was last wound, most clockwork keepers wind all their clockworks at a set time, typically 8 a.m.

A clockwork that lists standby in its wind-up entry can enter standby mode as a 3-action activity. Its operational time doesn't decrease in standby, but it can sense its surroundings (with a -2 penalty to Perception). It can't act, with one exception: when it perceives a creature, it can exit standby as a reaction (rolling initiative if appropriate).

A creature can attempt to Disable a Device to wind a clockwork down (with a DC listed in the wind-up entry). For each success, the clockwork loses 1 hour of operational time. This can be done even if the clockwork is in standby mode.

Explosive End.name: Explosive End
Explosive End.description:
Trigger The aurocan drops to 0 HP

Effect The aurocan detonates. Every creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] takes @Damage[3d12[bludgeoning],3d8[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:23|basic] save). On a critical failure, a creature is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Blistering Touch.name: Blistering Touch
Blistering Touch.description: The aurocan funnels some of the steam powering it into its body, heating up its metal frame. For the next minute, its melee Strikes deal an additional 1d6 fire damage.

Head of Steam.name: Head of Steam
Head of Steam.description:
Requirements The aurocan has used Blistering Touch within the past 2 rounds, and its head is attached

Effect The aurocan expels a cloud of steam as its head detaches. The head occupies a 5-foot square and has a fly Speed of 15 feet. As part of this action, and every time the aurocan Sustains it on a subsequent round, the head can Fly up to its Speed, blasting steam directly downward as it moves. Each creature whose space it passes no more than 5 feet above during its flight takes @Damage[4d6[fire]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic] save). On a failed save, a creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} by the steam for 1 round (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} on a critical failure).

While its head is detached, the aurocan can't make horn Strikes, but it can perform all other actions normally. The head has an AC of 27, Hardness 10, and the same saving throws, immunities, weaknesses, and resistances as the aurocan. If the head takes 20 damage in a single attack, it falls to the ground broken, and the aurocan is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round. If the head reenters the aurocan's space, it reattaches.

Ezio Gaeta.name: Ezio Gaeta
Ezio Gaeta.hp: coffin restoration, fast healing 7, void healing

Children of the Night.name: Children of the Night
Children of the Night.description: Ezio's presence brings forth creatures of the night to do his bidding. Ezio can give telepathic orders to these creatures as long as they're within 100 feet, but they can't communicate back. Ezio prefers to keep the company of rat swarms.

Cloud of Plague.name: Cloud of Plague
Cloud of Plague.description:
Trigger Ezio is reduced to 0 HP

Effect Ezio's body explodes in a bloody mist that carries a deadly plague. Each living creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save or contract choking death at stage 1 (stage 2 on a critical failure). Ezio bursts forth from the corpse of the first creature to die of this affliction, fully healed, but if all affected creatures are cured of the disease, Ezio is permanently destroyed.

Coffin Restoration.name: Coffin Restoration
