Coffin Restoration.description: Unlike other undead, a vampire isn't destroyed at 0 HP. Instead, it falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}. If its body rests in its coffin for 1 hour, the vampire gains 1 HP, after which its fast healing begins to function normally.

Hypnotic Gaze.name: Hypnotic Gaze
Hypnotic Gaze.description: 30 feet. Even when he's not attempting to Dominate a creature, Ezio uses his power over others' minds to subtly befuddle them, helping enable his plots. Creatures in the aura take a –1 status penalty to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} and Perception DCs against Ezio. When a creature ends its turn in Ezio's aura, it must attempt a @Check[will|dc:22] save. On a failure, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round on a critical failure).

Vampire Vulnerabilities.name: Vampire Vulnerabilities
Vampire Vulnerabilities.description:
All vampires possess the following vulnerabilities.

  • Compulsions Vampires are creatures with strange and unknowable compulsions. A typical vampire can't voluntarily cross running water unless they're transported while they hide within their coffin, nor can they enter a private dwelling unless invited in by someone with the authority to do so. At your discretion, vampires might have different compulsions—a pirate vampire might not be able to set foot on solid ground without being invited, for example. The vampire can still be forced to do these things and might be able to overcome their compulsion just as they do their revulsion.
  • Revulsion A vampire can't voluntarily come within 10 feet of brandished garlic or a brandished religious symbol of a deity with a holy sanctification option. To brandish garlic or a religious symbol, a creature must Interact to do so, and it remains brandished for 1 round (similar to Raising a Shield). If the vampire involuntarily comes within 10 feet of an object of their revulsion, they gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition, running from the object of their revulsion until they end an action beyond 10 feet. After 1 round of being exposed to the subject of their revulsion, a vampire can attempt a @Check[will|dc:25] save as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. On a success, they overcome their revulsions for [[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6 rounds} (or 1 hour on a critical success).
  • Stake A wooden stake driven through a vampire's heart drops the vampire to 0 HP and prevents them from healing above 0 HP, even in their coffin. Staking a vampire requires 3 actions and works only if the vampire is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}. If the stake is removed, the vampire can heal above 0 HP again, and if they're in their coffin, the 1-hour rest period begins once the stake is removed. If the vampire's head is severed and anointed with holy water while the stake is in place, the vampire is destroyed.
  • Sunlight If exposed to direct sunlight, a vampire immediately becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}. The slowed value increases by 1 each time the vampire ends their turn in sunlight, and the condition ends when they're no longer in sunlight. If the vampire loses all their actions in this way, they're destroyed. Due to their supernatural aversion to light, vampires don't cast shadows or show a reflection in mirrors

Biting Flies.name: Biting Flies
Biting Flies.description: Each creature that shares a space with Ezio takes @Damage[3d8[piercing]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save. On a critical failure, Ezio also gains the benefits of Drinking that creature's Blood.

Change Shape.name: Change Shape
Change Shape.description:
Ezio transforms into a swarm of Tiny flies. While in this form, he has the swarm trait and gains weakness 7 to area and splash damage. He has a land Speed of 20 feet and a fly Speed of 30 feet, and can fit into spaces only a few inches wide, moving his constituent creatures through the gap. He can't make any of his normal Strikes but gains the Biting Flies action.

Biting Flies 1 Each creature that shares a space with Ezio takes @Damage[3d8[piercing]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save. On a critical failure, Ezio also gains the benefits of Drinking that creature's Blood.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

Create Servitor.name: Create Servitor
Create Servitor.description:
If a creature dies after being reduced to 0 HP by Drink Blood, Ezio can turn this victim into a vampire servitor by donating some of their own blood to the victim and burying the victim in earth for 3 nights.

A vampiric servitor is compelled to obey its creator, but if Ezio controls too many vampiric servitors at once (as determined by the GM), or if the servitor is a higher level than Ezio that created it, strong-willed servitors can free themselves by succeeding at a @Check[will|dc:25] saving throw.

Dominate.name: Dominate
Dominate.description:
Ezio can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OsOhx3TGIZ7AhD0P]{Dominate} at will as a divine innate spell. Casting it requires staring into the target's eyes, giving the spell the visual trait (@Check[will|dc:23]). A creature that succeeds is temporarily immune to that vampire's Dominate for 24 hours.

Fully destroying Ezio ends the domination, but merely reducing Ezio to 0 HP is insufficient to break the spell.

Drink Blood.name: Drink Blood
Drink Blood.description:
Requirement A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or willing creature is within Ezio's reach.

Effect Ezio sinks its fangs into that creature to drink its blood. This requires an @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] check against the victim's Fortitude DC if the victim is grabbed and is automatic for any of the other conditions.

The victim is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and Ezio regains HP equal to 10% of its maximum HP, gaining any excess HP as temporary Hit Points. Drinking Blood from a creature that's already drained doesn't restore any HP to Ezio but increases the victim's drained value by 1, killing the victim when it reaches drained 5.

A victim's drained condition decreases by 1 per week. A blood transfusion, which requires a @Check[medicine|dc:20|name:Blood Transfusion] check and sufficient blood or a blood donor, reduces the drain by 1 after 10 minutes.

Turn to Mist.name: Turn to Mist
Turn to Mist.description:
Ezio turns into a cloud of vapor, as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.V8wXOsoejQhe6CyG]{Vapor Form} spell, or back to its normal form. Ezio loses fast healing while in gaseous form.

Ezio can remain in this form indefinitely.

Sarcovalt.name: Sarcovalt
Sarcovalt.publicNotes:
Individual sarcovalts have almost no personal identities and incredibly short-term memories.

There are few creatures throughout the multiverse more bizarrely revolting than the sarcovalt, a fiend with the body of a fly and the head of a fleshless vulture skull. While a creature barely 2 feet long might not seem threatening, sarcovalt swarms can overwhelm entire villages. Sarcovalts' heads almost seem to be wholly separate entities from their bodies and will vomit up whatever they capture in their beaks hours later as putrid, coagulated sludge.
Sarcovalt.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. death effects

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Death Effects.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Death Effects

Aura of Blight.name: Aura of Blight
Aura of Blight.description:
15 feet. The sarcovalt is surrounded by a miasma of infection. An enemy that enters or ends their turn in the aura must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:19] save.

Success The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to the aura for 1 minute.

Failure Until the end of its next turn, the creature takes a –1 circumstance penalty to saves against disease effects.

Critical Failure Until the end of its next turn, the creature takes a –2 circumstance bonus against disease effects and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

Befouled Body.name: Befouled Body
Befouled Body.description:
Any water the sarcovalt touches becomes diseased with filth fever.

Filth Fever (disease)

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:23|traits:disease]

Onset [[/br 1d4 #days]]{1d4 days}

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (1 day)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (1 day)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} (1 day)

Reactive Detach.name: Reactive Detach
Reactive Detach.description:
Trigger The sarcovalt takes slashing damage from a creature while they have another creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}

Effect The sarcovalt uses Detach Head. Their head keeps the other creature grabbed or restrained, and their body Steps. The sarcovalt gains resistance 5 to the triggering slashing damage.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.78Dfh5ghvULGiyzk]{Effect: Reactive Detach}

Return to Sender.name: Return to Sender
Return to Sender.description:
Trigger A creature escapes from being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by the sarcovalt's detached head

Effect The sarcovalt's head returns to their body via the shortest possible path. Any creature in a straight line between the head and the body must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:21] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} on a critical failure). The sarcovalt Dismisses Detach Head.

Detach Head.name: Detach Head
Detach Head.description:
Trigger The sarcovalt takes damage from a critical hit with a slashing weapon or has their head removed (such as by a vorpal weapon)

Effect The sarcovalt can survive decapitation and isn't killed if an effect that removes their head would kill them. Instead, the sarcovalt's head becomes detached from their body. The detached head has the same statistics as the body (except for the aura of blight) and gains the minion trait. The sarcovalt's body can issue a verbal command to the detached head as a single action, giving the head 2 actions. The detached head and body share the same pool of Hit Points.

While their head is detached, the sarcovalt's body can't make beak Strikes or use Malodorous Shriek. The detached head can only Climb, Fly, Stride, make beak Strikes, or use Malodorous Shriek.

Malodorous Shriek.name: Malodorous Shriek
Malodorous Shriek.description: The sarcovalt screeches through their skull (detached or not), spraying whatever festering viscera remains in their head in a @Template[type:cone|distance:20]. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[3d6[sonic],3d6[poison]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic] save). The sarcovalt can't use this ability again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge this ability]]{1d4 rounds}.

Alceo Demetrias.name: Alceo Demetrias
Alceo Demetrias.blurb: Male aiuvarin human cleric of Milani

Defy Devils!.name: Defy Devils!
Defy Devils!.description:
Trigger A creature within 30 feet critically fails a saving throw or skill check against a devil, or a creature that worships devils or has a magical contract with a devil

Effect The triggering creature rerolls the check and must take the new result. It then becomes temporarily immune to Defy Devils! for 24 hours.

Divine Weapon of Milani.name: Divine Weapon of Milani
Divine Weapon of Milani.description:
Frequency once per turn

Trigger Alceo finishes Casting a Spell using one of his spell slots on his turn

Effect Milani blesses Alceo's morningstar. Until the end of his turn, his morningstar Strikes deal an additional @Damage[2d4[spirit]] damage or @Damage[2d6[spirit]] damage if the target is unholy.

Sense Heartbond.name: Sense Heartbond
Sense Heartbond.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect Alceo learns Phoebe's present state. He knows her direction and distance, and any conditions affecting her.

Ritual Backlash.name: Ritual Backlash
Ritual Backlash.disable: @Check[occultism|dc:20] or @Check[religion|dc:20] three times to suppress the backlash of energy, or defeat Viro Ahala
Ritual Backlash.hazarddescription: The space above the flame in the ivory bowl wavers and the smell of brimstone assaults the senses.
Ritual Backlash.routine: (3 actions) The hazard makes a ranged mindburn Strike, creates a Pulse of Fear, and bestows Vitality of Hell to Viro or one of his allies at random. If it's reduced to 2 actions, the hazard doesn't create a Pulse of Fear. If reduced to 1 action, the hazard only bestows Vitality of Hell.
Ritual Backlash.reset: Once Viro Ahala has been defeated, this trap can't be reset.

Pulse of Fear.name: Pulse of Fear
Pulse of Fear.description: Each of Viro's enemies in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] from the ivory bowl must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:18] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure).

Vitality of Hell.name: Vitality of Hell
Vitality of Hell.description:
Viro or one of his allies gains 1d6 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.bwEZazVhE5KkLfwA]{Effect: Vitality of Hell}

Lash Out.name: Lash Out
Lash Out.description:
Trigger Viro Ahala rolls initiative

Effect Viro's lack of full attention unleashes the latent magical energy of the cave. The hazard creates a Pulse of Fear and then rolls initiative.

Godclaw Hellcrown.name: Godclaw Hellcrown
Godclaw Hellcrown.publicNotes:
Hellcrowns are a known hazard when fighting any order of Hellknights, especially so when those knights hail from the Order of the Godclaw. These hellcrowns seem to have a much better grasp on the necromancy that weaves through their existence and have been reported to form spectral weapons from their ghostly bodies that they can whip at their foes at a moment's notice. These are some of the most dangerous hellcrowns one can meet.

Those well-versed in the art of fighting against Hellknights warn their comrades to avoid decapitating their foes. This is because a Hellknight's unearthly loyalty can sometimes imbue their helmet with void energy, resulting in a restless spirit called a hellcrown. Hellcrowns float through the air, their ghostly bodies resembling smoky apparitions of the armor they once wore in life, and though they retain their twisted allegiance to their cause, little else remains of their former humanity and sense of self.

Hellcrowns don't join their living counterparts in armies or regiments, preferring to haunt the bloody battle sites where they originally fell. The strength of a hellcrown varies depending on the might of the living soldier who fell and the power of their enmity toward the cause of their death. In some cases, particularly powerful hellcrowns have access to spells and even form ghostly swarms to seek vengeance against any they deem responsible for their deaths.

Agony Lash.name: Agony Lash
Agony Lash.description: A creature damaged by the godclaw hellcrown's spectral lash Strike must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:23] save. On a failure, the tip of the lash is embedded in the creature, dealing @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] damage and imparting a –5-foot status penalty to the target's Speeds for 1 minute. Each additional embedded tip increases the bleed damage by 1 and the penalty to Speed by 5 feet. A creature can remove a tip with an Interact action to reduce the amount of bleed damage and the penalty to Speed. Pulling out the last tip removes both conditions.

Forbidding Stare.name: Forbidding Stare
Forbidding Stare.description: All creatures that can see the hellcrown and are affected by agony lash must attempt a @Check[will|dc:25] saving throw. A creature that fails is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}, and on a critical failure, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for as long as it's frightened. Regardless of the result, the creature is then temporarily immune to Forbidding Stare for 10 minutes.

False Hellbreaker.name: False Hellbreaker
False Hellbreaker.publicNotes:
Guards are rank-and-file members of a town watch or city guard, trained to look for trouble, take down criminals, and follow orders.

Larger societies rely on those with the authority and the ability to interpret and enforce laws. Some carry out these duties fairly, but others are harsh and cruel, imposing severe punishments on anyone unable to pay for clemency.

+1 Bonus on Perception to Find concealed.name: +1 Bonus on Perception to Find concealed objects

Block the Path.name: Block the Path
Block the Path.description: The false Hellbreaker prepares to harry anyone who tries to move past them. If it hits a creature with a Reactive Strike triggered by a move action, the triggering creature treats any squares within the steward's guard's reach as difficult terrain until the start of the false Hellbreaker's next turn.

Thin Ice.name: Thin Ice
Thin Ice.disable: @Check[nature|dc:31] or @Check[survival|dc:31] (expert) to spread out and prevent the ice from cracking further, or @Check[acrobatics|dc:31] or @Check[athletics|dc:31] (trained) to get off the ice safely as it cracks.
Thin Ice.hazarddescription: The white-and-blue ice is less structurally sound than it looks.
Thin Ice.reset: The river freezes over every night, restoring this hazard. The hazard disappears once the vernal equinox passes.

Crack.name: Crack
Crack.description:
Trigger Two or more creatures step onto the ice in area M8

Effect The ice beneath the party cracks. All creatures in area M8 must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:30] save. On a failure, they fall into the freezing water, whereupon they must succeed at a basic @Check[fortitude|dc:30] save against @Damage[(4d10+22)[cold]] damage. On a critical failure, the creature must start holding their breath or risk drowning as their muscles lock and they begin to sink. A creature must spend an action to Swim to the shore and must then succeed at a @Check[athletics|dc:30] check to Climb up out of the water.

Breathless Thicket.name: Breathless Thicket
Breathless Thicket.disable: @Check[nature|dc:28] (expert) or @Check[survival|dc:28] (expert) to recognize the thicket for what it is and avoid it
Breathless Thicket.hazarddescription: A 10-foot-wide patch of dead shrubs with wilted flowers steals the breath of the living.
Breathless Thicket.routine: (3 actions) The breathless thickets patch attempts to Strike a creature in its reach. It then uses Suffocate if it has any creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}; otherwise, it continues to Strike.
Breathless Thicket.reset: The thicket goes back into hibernation 1 round after there are no more targets to Strike in its reach. It then remains dormant for 24 hours.
Breathless Thicket.stealthdetails: (expert; or –10 and no minimum proficiency if the thicket has been recognized)

Branch Ambush.name: Branch Ambush
Branch Ambush.description:
Trigger A creature that breathes steps within 5 feet of a thicket

Effect The thicket makes a sinewy leaves Strike against the triggering creature. The hazard then rolls initiative.

Branch Grab.name: Branch Grab
Branch Grab.description: If the breathless thicket hits a creature with its leaves, that creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the thicket. Unlike with a normal Grab, the creature isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, but it can't move beyond the reach of the thicket's leaves. A creature can sever a branch by Striking against AC 18 and dealing at least @Damage[12[slashing]] damage. A branch doesn't have the thicket's Hardness, and damaging it doesn't deal damage to the thicket ([[/act escape dc=26]]).

Suffocate.name: Suffocate
Suffocate.description:
Requirements The breathless thicket has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} one or more creatures that breathe

Effect The dead flowers of the breathless thicket begin pulling oxygen from its victims' lungs. Each creature grabbed by the breathless thicket takes @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]|traits:nonlethal]{4d6 nonlethal bludgeoning} damage and must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:26] save.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage and can immediately attempt to [[/act escape dc=26]] as a free action.

Success The creature takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The creature takes full damage, is stupefied 1 for 1 round, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}. For as long as it's grabbed by the thicket, the creature must hold its breath or suffocate.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature also falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and starts suffocating. If it's no longer grabbed, the creature stops suffocating.

Hecatinia.name: Hecatinia
Hecatinia.publicNotes:
Often leading a small team of lower-ranking guards, watch officers patrol their assigned areas to maintain order and enforce laws. Watch officers get the job done, though their methods aren't always gentle or kind.

Larger societies rely on those with the authority and the ability to interpret and enforce laws. Some carry out these duties fairly, but others are harsh and cruel, imposing severe punishments on anyone unable to pay for clemency.

Air of Authority.name: Air of Authority
Air of Authority.description: 10 feet. Creatures in the aura who are the same or lower level than the watch officer take a -2 status penalty to their Will DC against the watch officer's attempts to [[/act coerce]] or [[/act demoralize]] them.

Bravery.name: Bravery
Bravery.description: When the watch officer rolls a success on a Will save against a fear effect, they get a critical success instead. In addition, any time they gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition, reduce its value by 1.

Hunter's Fatigue.name: Hunter's Fatigue
Hunter's Fatigue.description: Having fought undead nonstop for the entire day, both Hellknights have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} condition. The condition goes away as usual with a full night's rest.

Sudden Charge.name: Sudden Charge
Sudden Charge.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The watch officer Strides twice. If they end their movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, they can make a melee Strike against that enemy.

Ravenous Pit.name: Ravenous Pit
Ravenous Pit.disable: @Check[nature|dc:23] or @Check[occultism|dc:23] (expert) three times to disperse the unusual energy surrounding the hole, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (3rd rank; counteract DC 22) to counteract the engulfing magic
Ravenous Pit.hazarddescription: A seemingly ordinary hole in the forest floor exerts a strange gravity on creatures that come near.
Ravenous Pit.routine:
(2 actions) For each action, the pit chooses a different creature within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] to attempt to swallow. That creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save. On a failure, the creature is pulled 5 feet closer to the hole (10 feet on a critical failure). If this would pull the creature into the pit, that creature can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge} as a reaction (DC 22). A creature who falls into the pit disappears into an extradimensional space that feels like being buried alive. A creature takes @Damage[(2d8+7)[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:20|basic] save) at the end of each its turns in the extradimensional space. A creature in this extradimensional space is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}; they can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} this extradimensional space with a successful @Check[athletics|dc:22], Nature, or Survival check. If they succeed, they appear in a random spot no more than 10 feet from the hole as if they had clawed their way from the dirt.

While this trap is active, all creatures treat movement away from the pit as difficult terrain.
Ravenous Pit.reset: If the trap isn't disabled, it becomes dormant for 10 minutes if there are no creatures within 20 feet of it at the start of its turn.

Deadly Inhale.name: Deadly Inhale
Deadly Inhale.description:
Trigger A creature approaches within 15 feet of the hole

Effect The ravenous pit seems to "inhale," attempting to pull creatures into itself. Each creature within 15 feet must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save. On a failure, the creature is pulled 5 feet closer to the hole (10 feet on a critical failure). The pit then rolls initiative.

Littler Beasts.name: Littler Beasts
Littler Beasts.disable: @Check[nature|dc:20] or @Check[occultism|dc:20] twice to disperse the warped magic around the tree, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (2nd rank; counteract DC 19) to counteract the warped magic
Littler Beasts.hazarddescription: At first, the tree looks small. Then the space around it warps to give the impression that it's a normalsized tree seen at a distance.
Littler Beasts.routine: (1 action) The trap targets a random creature within 60 feet to try to bring it down to its size. That creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:20] save. On a failure, the creature becomes Tiny in size until the beginning of its next turn. An affected creature's equipment shrinks with it but returns to its original size if removed. The creature's reach changes to 0 feet. This is a polymorph effect that has no effect on a Tiny creature. On a critical failure, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for the same duration.
Littler Beasts.reset: If the trap isn't disabled, it becomes dormant for 10 minutes if there are no creatures within 60 feet of it at the start of its turn.

Action.name: Action
Action.description:
Trigger A creature approaches within 30 feet of the tree

Effect The tree seems to grow and shrink simultaneously. Each creature within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] must attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] saving throw. The trap then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of its next turn from the disorientation.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} as if unsure of the distance between places.

Critical Failure As failure, but @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2}.

Gang Determination.name: Gang Determination
Gang Determination.description: When a Chelaxian loyalist is adjacent to at least one other ally, they gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves.

Gang Determination.name: Gang Determination
Gang Determination.description: When a Chelaxian loyalist is adjacent to at least one other ally, they gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves.

For Cheliax!.name: For Cheliax!
For Cheliax!.description: The Chelaxian loyalist leader Strides, shouting a Chelaxian slogan of loyalty. If they end the movement adjacent to a foe, they make a morningstar Strike against that foe. Each ally who hears and sees the loyalist leader attack can spend their reaction to Stride toward that foe.

+3 to Reflex Saves vs. Area Effects.name: +3 to Reflex Saves vs. Area Effects

Punishing Cut.name: Punishing Cut
Punishing Cut.description: Viro makes a longsword Strike. This counts as two attacks for his multiple attack penalty. If the Strike hits, it deals an additional die of weapon damage and 1d4 persistent bleed damage.

Shielded Charge.name: Shielded Charge
Shielded Charge.description:
Requirements Viro is wielding a shield

Effect Viro Raises his Shield and then Strides twice. If he ends his movement adjacent to a foe, that foe is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to Viro's Strikes until the end of Viro's current turn.

Creatures of the Night.name: Creatures of the Night
Creatures of the Night.disable: @Check[nature|dc:24] or @Check[religion|dc:24] (trained) to scatter the vermin; two successes are required to disable it
Creatures of the Night.hazarddescription: Bats and rats swarm around Ezio's enemies.
Creatures of the Night.routine: (1 action) The bats and rats bite all creatures in the room, doing @Damage[(2d8+3)[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic] save). On a failure, the creature also takes @Damage[3[persistent,bleed]] damage.

Infest.name: Infest
Infest.description:
Trigger Ezio summons the swarms

Effect The swarms coalesce in nauseating fashion. Each creature in the room must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure). The hazard then rolls initiative.

Prison Break.name: Prison Break
Prison Break.disable: @Check[athletics|dc:27] to stop the prisoners in their tracks, @Check[diplomacy|dc:30] to reason with the mob, or @Check[intimidation|dc:27] to cow them into calming down
Prison Break.hazarddescription: A prison mob makes a break for freedom, trampling anything in its path.
Prison Break.routine:
(1 action) Prisoners trample toward the exit, dealing @Damage[(2d10+9)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage to each living creature in area K9 and the hallway north of it (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save). On a critical failure, the creature's grasp on anything it's carrying is weakened as if the hazard succeeded on a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} attempt. If its grasp was already weakened, they drop the item.

Special If the PCs have not defeated the hazard after 4 rounds, it automatically ends as all the prisoners escape.

Rush to Freedom.name: Rush to Freedom
Rush to Freedom.description:
Trigger The door to holding cell B opens

Effect The hazard grabs at the weapons of any creatures within 20 feet of the door, attempting to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} them with a +19 modifier, and then rolls initiative.

Vampire Vulnerabilities.name: Vampire Vulnerabilities
Vampire Vulnerabilities.description:
All vampires possess the following vulnerabilities.

  • Compulsions Vampires are creatures with strange and unknowable compulsions. A typical vampire can't voluntarily cross running water unless they're transported while they hide within their coffin, nor can they enter a private dwelling unless invited in by someone with the authority to do so. At your discretion, vampires might have different compulsions—a pirate vampire might not be able to set foot on solid ground without being invited, for example. The vampire can still be forced to do these things and might be able to overcome their compulsion just as they do their revulsion.
  • Revulsion A vampire can't voluntarily come within 10 feet of brandished garlic or a brandished religious symbol of a deity with a holy sanctification option. To brandish garlic or a religious symbol, a creature must Interact to do so, and it remains brandished for 1 round (similar to Raising a Shield). If the vampire involuntarily comes within 10 feet of an object of their revulsion, they gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition, running from the object of their revulsion until they end an action beyond 10 feet. After 1 round of being exposed to the subject of their revulsion, a vampire can attempt a @Check[will|dc:25] save as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. On a success, they overcome their revulsions for [[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6 rounds} (or 1 hour on a critical success).
  • Stake A wooden stake driven through a vampire's heart drops the vampire to 0 HP and prevents them from healing above 0 HP, even in their coffin. Staking a vampire requires 3 actions and works only if the vampire is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}. If the stake is removed, the vampire can heal above 0 HP again, and if they're in their coffin, the 1-hour rest period begins once the stake is removed. If the vampire's head is severed and anointed with holy water while the stake is in place, the vampire is destroyed.
  • Sunlight If exposed to direct sunlight, a vampire immediately becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}. The slowed value increases by 1 each time the vampire ends their turn in sunlight, and the condition ends when they're no longer in sunlight. If the vampire loses all their actions in this way, they're destroyed. Due to their supernatural aversion to light, vampires don't cast shadows or show a reflection in mirrors

Dominate.name: Dominate
Dominate.description:
The vampire can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OsOhx3TGIZ7AhD0P]{Dominate} at will as a divine innate spell. Casting it requires staring into the target's eyes, giving the spell the visual trait (@Check[will|dc:22]). A creature that succeeds is temporarily immune to that vampire's Dominate for 24 hours.

Fully destroying the vampire ends the domination, but merely reducing the vampire to 0 HP is insufficient to break the spell.

Drink Blood.name: Drink Blood
Drink Blood.description:
Requirement A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or willing creature is within the vampire's reach.

Effect The vampire sinks its fangs into that creature to drink its blood. This requires an @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] check against the victim's Fortitude DC if the victim is grabbed and is automatic for any of the other conditions.

The victim is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and the vampire regains @Damage[10[healing]] HP, gaining any excess HP as temporary Hit Points. Drinking Blood from a creature that's already drained doesn't restore any HP to the vampire but increases the victim's drained value by 1, killing the victim when it reaches drained 5. A vampire can also consume blood that's been emptied into a vessel for sustenance, but it gains no HP from doing so.

A victim's drained condition decreases by 1 per week. A blood transfusion, which requires a @Check[medicine|dc:20|name:Blood Transfusion] check and sufficient blood or a blood donor, reduces the drain by 1 after 10 minutes.

Spellstrike.name: Spellstrike
Spellstrike.description:
Frequency until recharged

Effect Hedvend VI channels a spell into his claw Strike to deliver a combined attack. He Casts a Spell that requires a spell attack roll. The effects of the spell don't occur immediately but are imbued into his attack instead. He attempts a claw melee Strike, with the attack roll determining the effects of both the Strike and the spell. This counts as two attacks for his multiple attack penalty, but he doesn't apply the penalty until after he's completed the Spellstrike. The infusion of spell energy grants his Strike the arcane trait, making it magical. After he uses Spellstrike, he can't do so again until he recharges his Spellstrike as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. He also recharge his Spellstrike when he Drinks Blood.

Zombie Giant Bat.name: Zombie Giant Bat
Zombie Giant Bat.publicNotes:
While big bats are certainly not uncommon in dark caves and abandoned ruins and may instill fear in squeamish spelunkers, the so-called giant bat is a true monster, weighing well over 100 pounds and having a wingspan of nearly 15 feet. It primarily eats fruit and bugs, but can be incited to violence through fear or hunger. Giant bat attacks can quickly give rise to rumors of more dangerous monsters—many mistake these massive animals for some sort of demon or vampiric monster. But like other bats, giant bats are simply social and intelligent mammals. They are sometimes used as mounts by smaller humanoids, commonly those who hail from or dwell in mountainous or underground regions.

A wide range of bats dwell throughout the world. Most of these nocturnal animals are harmless insectivores, but deadly breeds of vampire bats and oversized bats the size of horses pose much more significant threats to adventurers.

Slow.name: Slow
Slow.description: A zombie is permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and can't use reactions.

Clumsy Flier.name: Clumsy Flier
Clumsy Flier.description: While a zombie giant bat can fly, its wings are barely able to keep it aloft. If it's airborne when it takes a critical hit or any amount of slashing damage, it falls and it can't Fly on its next turn.

Rotting Aura.name: Rotting Aura
Rotting Aura.description: 10 feet. The zombie giant bat emits an aura of rot and disease that cause wounds to fester. Any living creature that starts its turn within the aura and isn't at full Hit Points takes @Damage[1d6[void]] damage.

Practice Guard's Grasp.name: Practice Guard's Grasp
Practice Guard's Grasp.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:18] (trained) to jam the net or @Check[athletics|dc:25] to knock the dummy over
Practice Guard's Grasp.hazarddescription: A spring-loaded net fires from the dummy, then is pulled tightly back in with magnets.

Got You!.name: Got You!
Got You!.description:
Trigger A creature moves adjacent to the trap

Effect The creature must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:23] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} on a critical failure). The DC to Escape is [[/act escape dc=23]], or the net can be cut by doing 6 acid, fire, or slashing damage to it.

Adiutor.name: Adiutor
Adiutor.publicNotes:
Adiutors, while nicknamed auxiliary devils, are not truly devils, but mortals invested with infernal power. These mortals gain a taste of Hell's might as rewards for their loyalty to the cause of tyranny and oppression. Hungry for power, an adiutor ruthlessly enforces Hell's will at any cost in hopes of fulfilling their fiendish ambitions. They're most commonly found in Cheliax and its territories due to the nation's relationship with the forces of Hell, serving as spies and informants for both the Thrunes and powerful devils invested in meddling with mortals.

While some adiutors climb the ranks of mortal society to become Hellknights and other supporters of tyranny, most have higher ambitions and desire to become devils themselves. To this end, they seek to serve more powerful devils and make deals that will benefit them so that they can ensure their transformation. There's nothing an adiutor despises more than their own mortality—a sign of weakness, when beings like devils walk the Universe in their perfect Hellish vision.

Although they're most likely to be found in places or near people with existing links to Hell, adiutors can be found anywhere, quietly plotting to gain power and status so they can become the lieutenants of Hell they desire to be.

Avernian Armskote.name: Avernian Armskote
Avernian Armskote.description: An adiutor reloads by magically conjuring hellfire rounds crafted in the Fools' Citadels of Avernus. Their Strikes with their flintlock muskets are magical and deal an additional 2d6 fire damage.

Fiendish Reload.name: Fiendish Reload
Fiendish Reload.description: When the adiutor reloads their musket, they can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TVKNbcgTee19PXZR]{Shield} as part of the same action.

Punish the Wayward.name: Punish the Wayward
Punish the Wayward.description:
The adiutor makes a melee or ranged Strike. If this Strike succeeds, the targeted creature takes the normal damage and must additionally attempt a @Check[will|dc:22] save.

Critical Success The creature suffers no additional effects.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is frightened 1. While it can see the adiutor, it can't reduce its frightened condition.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to the adiutor while frightened.

Instillo.name: Instillo
Instillo.publicNotes: Wherever learning and instruction is called for within the burning shadows of Hell, from the bureaus of Dis and coffers of Erebus to the war colleges of Malebolge and Caina's courtrooms, docent devils ply their unassuming and perspicacious trade. The instillo, so named for their creativity and talent in instilling a respect for Hell's ways and legitimacy to captive audiences, are valued for their ability to transform recently conquered lands into compliant, even loyal, client-states. The conquered are taught to be ashamed of their origins; the despairing are issued philosophies that displace blame and uncertainty upon the mistakes of history and geography; the orphaned are taught to respect those who orphaned them.
Instillo.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Correcting Veil.name: Correcting Veil
Correcting Veil.description: 100 feet. The instillo's telepathic presence constantly monitors perspectives and molds thought toward an infernal clarity. Creatures within the aura gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1Bt7uCW2WI4sM84P]{Dubious Knowledge} skill feat but are unaware of this effect. The instillo is instantly aware when any creature within the aura fails a Recall Knowledge check and influences the erroneous information that the creature gains.

Nod of the Tongue.name: Nod of the Tongue
Nod of the Tongue.description: Creatures who can understand Diabolic take a –2 status penalty to their Will saves against the instillo's effects with the auditory or mental trait.

Quiet Confidence.name: Quiet Confidence
Quiet Confidence.description: The instillo can hide the source of their magic. If the next action the instillo uses is to Cast a Spell, that spell gains the subtle trait. The trait hides only the spell's spellcasting actions and manifestations, not its effects.

Sneak Attack.name: Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description: The instillo's Strikes deal an additional 2d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Superlative Rhetoric.name: Superlative Rhetoric
Superlative Rhetoric.description:
Frequency once per round

Requirements The instillo's most recent action was to cast a spell with the auditory trait

Effect The instillo immediately casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4gBIw4IDrSfFHik4]{Daze} at a creature that can hear them.

Lights Out.name: Lights Out
Lights Out.disable: @Check[occultism|dc:18] (trained) to ward off the darkness or @Check[deception|dc:19] or @Check[performance|dc:19] (trained) to pretend to be asleep; two total success are required to disable the haunt
Lights Out.hazarddescription: Patches of darkness envelop the rickety beds in this room, from which can be heard the sounds of gentle snoring from children.
Lights Out.routine: (1 action; darkness, occult) The haunt randomly chooses 1 living creature that it hadn't engulfed in darkness the previous round. Supernatural darkness wells over that creature, who must attempt a @Check[will|dc:18] save. On a failure, that creature is engulfed in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] of darkness centered on them and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round. Any creatures in the emanation must attempt their own Will save or become blinded as well. Any non-magical light sources and magical light of 1st rank or lower the primary creature is holding or wearing cease to give off light for that duration.
Lights Out.reset: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all living creatures leave the room but resets immediately thereafter. If disabled, the haunt resets after 1 day. The haunt is permanently destroyed when the attic whisperer here is destroyed.

Lullaby and Good Night.name: Lullaby and Good Night
Lullaby and Good Night.description:
Trigger At least two living creatures enter the room

Effect The sounds of a soothing lullaby fill the air. All living creatures in the room must attempt a @Check[will|dc:22] save. The haunt then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature gets slightly drowsy, taking a –1 status penalty to Perception checks for 1 round.

Failure The creature briefly nods off. They are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and can't use reactions for 1 round after that.

Critical Failure As failure, but @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2}.

Hunt Prey.name: Hunt Prey
Hunt Prey.description:
The Isgeri Slayer designates a single creature they can see and hear, or one they're Tracking, as their prey.

The slayer gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to [[/act seek]] the prey and to Survival checks to [[/act track]] the prey.

The first time the slayer hits the designated prey in a round, they deal an additional 1d8 precision damage. The slayer also ignores the penalty for making ranged attacks within their second range increment. These effects last until the poacher uses Hunt Prey again.

Twin Takedown.name: Twin Takedown
Twin Takedown.description:
Requirements The Isgeri Slayer is wielding two melee weapons, each in a different hand

Effect The Isgeri Slayer swiftly attacks their hunted prey with each of their weapons, potentially combining their damage into a single devastating attack. They make two Strikes against their hunted prey, one with each of the required weapons. If both hit the same hunted prey, combine their damage for the purpose of its resistances and weaknesses. The Isgeri Slayer applies their multiple attack penalty to each Strike normally.

Varlario Demicci.name: Varlario Demicci
Varlario Demicci.blurb: Agender agent of the Whispering Way

Shadow Blending.name: Shadow Blending
Shadow Blending.description:
Frequency once per minute

Trigger A creature attempts a flat check to target Varlario while they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} due to dim light or darkness

Effect Shadows wrap around Varlario's form. The DC of the flat check increases by 2.

Hidden Familiar.name: Hidden Familiar
Hidden Familiar.description: Varlario has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} their bat familiar through the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.F1nlmqOIucch3Cmt]{Pet Cache} spell. They keep the bat contained except when they use shred spirit.

Shred Spirit.name: Shred Spirit
Shred Spirit.description:
Frequency once per minute

Effect Varlario sends forth their bat familiar as a phantasmal conduit to rip at the soul of a creature within 30 feet. The targeted creature must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:26|basic] save or take @Damage[9d6[spirit]] damage. Varlario then recovers Hit Points equal to half the damage dealt.

Claw of Pain.name: Claw of Pain
Claw of Pain.description: When the sister targets the same creature with two Strikes from her Flurry of Blows, she can cause lingering pain. If either Strike hits and deals damage, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:18] save or take @Damage[1d4[persistent,mental]] damage (and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} on a critical failure).

Flurry of Blows.name: Flurry of Blows
Flurry of Blows.description: The sister makes two fist Strikes, applying her multiple attack penalty as normal. If both hit the same creature, combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.

Spreading Fire.name: Spreading Fire
Spreading Fire.disable: @Check[athletics|dc:17] to splash the barrels of gall ink on the fire or @Check[survival|dc:15] to smother the flames
Spreading Fire.hazarddescription: A fire engulfs a 5-foot-by-5-foot area, then spreads on each of its turns.
Spreading Fire.routine: (1 action) On its turn, the fire spreads into a number of additional squares equal to half the number of squares the fire currently occupies, with a minimum of 1 square. You determine the squares the fire spreads into—typically those with the most flammable materials. Any creature that ends its turn next to the flames takes @Damage[1d6[fire]] damage, and any creature within the flames takes @Damage[4d6[fire]] damage. Both of these have a @Check[reflex|dc:17|basic] save. A creature can take damage from flames only once per round.

Spreading Flames.name: Spreading Flames
Spreading Flames.description:
Trigger A creature enters the printing house

Effect The flames swell at the influx of air and deal @Damage[1d6[fire]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic] save). The fire then rolls initiative.

Besunas.name: Besunas
Besunas.publicNotes: Wherever learning and instruction is called for within the burning shadows of Hell, from the bureaus of Dis and coffers of Erebus to the war colleges of Malebolge and Caina's courtrooms, docent devils ply their unassuming and perspicacious trade. The instillo, so named for their creativity and talent in instilling a respect for Hell's ways and legitimacy to captive audiences, are valued for their ability to transform recently conquered lands into compliant, even loyal, client-states. The conquered are taught to be ashamed of their origins; the despairing are issued philosophies that displace blame and uncertainty upon the mistakes of history and geography; the orphaned are taught to respect those who orphaned them.
Besunas.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Correcting Veil.name: Correcting Veil
Correcting Veil.description: 100 feet. The instillo's telepathic presence constantly monitors perspectives and molds thought toward an infernal clarity. Creatures within the aura gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1Bt7uCW2WI4sM84P]{Dubious Knowledge} skill feat but are unaware of this effect. The instillo is instantly aware when any creature within the aura fails a Recall Knowledge check and influences the erroneous information that the creature gains.

Nod of the Tongue.name: Nod of the Tongue
Nod of the Tongue.description: Creatures who can understand Diabolic take a –2 status penalty to their Will saves against the instillo's effects with the auditory or mental trait.

Quiet Confidence.name: Quiet Confidence
Quiet Confidence.description: The instillo can hide the source of their magic. If the next action the instillo uses is to Cast a Spell, that spell gains the subtle trait. The trait hides only the spell's spellcasting actions and manifestations, not its effects.

Sneak Attack.name: Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description: The instillo's Strikes deal an additional 2d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Superlative Rhetoric.name: Superlative Rhetoric
Superlative Rhetoric.description:
Frequency once per round

Requirements The instillo's most recent action was to cast a spell with the auditory trait

Effect The instillo immediately casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4gBIw4IDrSfFHik4]{Daze} at a creature that can hear them.

Drude.name: Drude
Drude.publicNotes:
A drude is a gorga who embodies the fear of haunted places at night. This shadowy, shapeshifting fey is drawn to places of great tragedy, loss, or conflict, where they prey on their victim's fear of their surroundings. A drude takes perverse pleasure in toying with their quarry, whom they terrorize and exhaust over the course of the night. Malicious but not truly malevolent, a drude typically stops short of causing death since that would put an end to their fun. When faced with a situation they can't win, this fey is more likely to flee than fight.

A drude's true form resembles an emaciated, tailless fox made of darkness and ghostly shadows, though a drude rarely reveals this true self to others. When a drude has set their sights on a target, they prefer to shift into a form better suited to infiltrating the victim's sleeping space, such as a stray dog, a nearby shrub, or an item nestled among the target's gear.

If the drude can't find a suitable location for their fun, they'll make one. They find the most isolated area they can and put on a great show to bring out the fear of any residents. The unfortunate people in the drude's chosen territory are stalked by strange figures, assailed by wailing sounds, and haunted by terrible nightmares—all tricks by the shapeshifting drude to create the perfect environment for themself. Very rarely, a drude might become attached to a particular victim and follow them to other locations, choosing to haunt them instead of a singular location.

Lay Bare.name: Lay Bare
Lay Bare.description: When a drude using Change Shape is reduced to fewer than half their Hit Points, they revert to their true form.

Nightmare Herald.name: Nightmare Herald
Nightmare Herald.description: 90 feet. A creature that sleeps within the drude's aura is tormented with horrific nightmares and must attempt a @Check[will|dc:18] save. On a failure, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 24 hours when it awakens. On a critical failure, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.

Change Shape.name: Change Shape
Change Shape.description:
The drude takes on the appearance of a Small animal or inanimate object. This doesn't affect their statistics, but it could change the damage type of their Strikes while in animal form.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

Haunting Echoes.name: Haunting Echoes
Haunting Echoes.description:
The drude targets a creature they can see within 30 feet and assaults it with illusions of ghosts and nightly terrors. The creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:18] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune for 24 hours.

Success The creature takes @Damage[1d6[mental]] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[1d6[mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[2d6[mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Gala Crowd.name: Gala Crowd
Gala Crowd.disable: @Check[intimidation|dc:19], @Check[diplomacy|dc:21], or @Check[athletics|dc:24] to get guests to move out of harm's way; four total successes across all skills are required to disable the hazard
Gala Crowd.hazarddescription: The panicked crowd of gala attendees reacts to the unexpected attack.
Gala Crowd.routine:
(1 action) The crowd reacts in one of the following ways, determined by a d12 die roll:

  • 1–2 Hunker Down: The crowd freezes in fear. It provides lesser cover to all creatures in the great room for 1 round.
  • 3–4 Run!: Determine a random direction. Each creature in the area must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:21] save or be moved 10 feet in that direction. On a critical failure, they're also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. This is forced movement.
  • 5–6 Hysteria: The crowd's dread is contagious. Each creature in the area must attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure). This is an emotion, fear, and mental effect.
  • 7–8 Wailing: The cries make it hard to concentrate. For 1 round, any creature in the area that attempts an action with the concentrate trait must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:4] or the action is disrupted. This is an auditory effect.
  • 9–10 Crushing Press: Members of the crowd shove and push, trying to find a way to safety. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[(2d8+5)[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:21|basic] save).

  • 11–12 Wild Dismay: The chaos is overwhelming. Each creature in the area must attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round. This is an emotion and mental effect.

Panic at the Gala.name: Panic at the Gala
Panic at the Gala.description:
Trigger A creature rolls initiative

Effect The crowd stampedes, dealing @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]] damage to anyone on the great room floor (@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic] save), then rolls initiative.

Skirmancer Mage.name: Skirmancer Mage
Skirmancer Mage.publicNotes:
A watchmage uses a mix of magic and martial training to enforce the law. They magically detect invisible criminals, locate stolen property, and counter illegal spells.

Larger societies rely on those with the authority and the ability to interpret and enforce laws. Some carry out these duties fairly, but others are harsh and cruel, imposing severe punishments on anyone unable to pay for clemency.

Arcane Watch.name: Arcane Watch
Arcane Watch.description: The watchmage can either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} while using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Yb0C1uLzeHrVLl7a]{Detect Magic} exploration activity.

Counter Escape.name: Counter Escape
Counter Escape.description:
Trigger A creature Casts a Spell with the teleportation trait or as a reaction

Effect The watchmage expends a spell slot of the same rank or higher as the trigger creature's spell and attempts to counteract the triggering spell (counteract modifier [[/r 1d20+11 #Counteract]]{+11}).

Eldritch Arms.name: Eldritch Arms
Eldritch Arms.description: In a brief ritual that takes 10 minutes, the watchmage chooses a single weapon or unarmed attack through which they can focus their magic. Strikes the watchmage makes with that weapon are magical and deal 1d6 additional force damage.

Spellbound Strike.name: Spellbound Strike
Spellbound Strike.description:
Requirements The watchmage is wielding the weapon chosen with Eldritch Arms

Effect The watchmage Casts a Spell that takes 1 or 2 actions to cast, imbuing that spell into the weapon. The watchmage Strikes with the required weapon. This counts as two attacks for the watchmage's multiple attack penalty. On a hit, the target is also affected by the spell, though the target gets any normal defenses allowed by the spell.

If the spell is targeted, it targets the creature that was hit and no one else. If the spell is an area, the target must be in the area. A burst is centered on a corner of the target's square if the target is Medium or smaller, or the corner of a square closest to the creature's center if it's Large or larger. A cone or line emits from a square of the watchmage's choice adjacent to the target.

Redcap.name: Redcap
Redcap.publicNotes:
Redcaps are sadistic and capricious fey who thrill in bloodletting and murder. While they are most famous for appearing as wizened, bearded men, redcaps of other genders are no less fearsome or cruel. However, redcaps are ultimately craven bullies, cowed by anything more powerful than themselves, a trait that leads them to fear and despise the symbols of deities.

Many fairy tales explain how the redcaps draw power from dipping the hats for which they are named in fresh blood. Just as iconic to these cruel little fey are their iron-clad boots, and the clanging sound of their metal soles clanking on stone floors is both discordant and disconcerting—especially to those who recognize the sound for what it is. Redcaps typically stand only 3 feet tall, with hunched frames, pointed ears, crooked teeth, and long, white, tangled hair.

Though unlikely to share true affection, redcaps find camaraderie in murder. Small troupes of redcaps travel together, sharing bloody kills and reminiscing on their brutal exploits. They loathe the company of most other creatures, with the notable exception of the feline fey called elananxes.

Red Cap.name: Red Cap
Red Cap.description:
A redcap's woolen hat is dyed with the blood of their victims. If the redcap loses their cap, they no longer benefit from fast healing and take a –4 status penalty to their damage rolls. They can create a new cap in 10 minutes, but that cap doesn't grant them powers until the redcap has turned it red with Blood Soak. A cap has no benefit for creatures other than the redcap who made it.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.s5mS7CyE0oOYlecv]{Effect: Lost Red Cap}

Divine Revulsion.name: Divine Revulsion
Divine Revulsion.description:
If a redcap sees a creature brandish a religious symbol of a deity (which requires an Interact action by that creature) or cast a divine spell while wearing a religious symbol, the redcap must attempt a @Check[will|dc:19] save. They then become temporarily immune to all brandished religious symbols for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The redcap is unaffected.

Success The redcap is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Failure The redcap gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition for 1 round and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}.

Blood Soak.name: Blood Soak
Blood Soak.description:
The redcap dips their cap in the blood of a slain foe. The foe must have died in the last minute, and the redcap must have helped kill it. The redcap gains a +4 status bonus to damage rolls for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.wPIGBcpCqCWgrCiq]{Effect: Blood Soak}

Deadly Cleave.name: Deadly Cleave
Deadly Cleave.description:
Trigger The redcap reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points with a halberd Strike

Effect The redcap makes another halberd Strike against a different creature, using the same multiple attack penalty as the halberd Strike that triggered this reaction. This counts toward their multiple attack penalty as normal.

Red Drip.name: Red Drip
Red Drip.description:
Whenever the redcap successfully Strikes a creature, that creature must attempt a Fortitude save against this debilitating fungal infection that slowly consumes a limb

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:22]

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} (1 day)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}, and using the infected limb deals @Damage[3d6[persistent,bleed]] damage (1 day)

Stage 3 clumsy 2, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}, and the infected limb is unusable (1 day)

Stage 4 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 3}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3}, and infected limb is permanently unusable (1 day)

Stage 5 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, and damage does not end the confused condition (1 day)

Stage 6 death

Stomp.name: Stomp
Stomp.description: The redcap Strides up to half its Speed and makes a boot Strike at any point during that movement. If the boot Strike hits a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} creature, it deals an extra @Damage[2d6[bleed]].

Hellknight Field-Maralictor.name: Hellknight Field-Maralictor
Hellknight Field-Maralictor.publicNotes:
Elite fighters from the lowest ranks of nobility, knights are proud champions of their court. Unlike other nobles, knights must earn their title through loyalty and strength-of-arms rather than inheritance. Ideals such as chivalry, honor, and virtue are associated with knights but not all meet such romantic standards.

The denizens of a noble court are the most powerful people in a civilization, primed with wealth, station, and authority above the common people.

Hellknight's Rigor.name: Hellknight's Rigor
Hellknight's Rigor.description: Any time the Hellknight field-maralictor gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition, they reduce its value by 1.

Quick Shield Block.name: Quick Shield Block
Quick Shield Block.description:
The Hellknight field-maralictor has an additional reaction they can use only to Shield Block.

They can Shield Block for an adjacent ally, preventing that ally from taking damage instead of protecting themself.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ShieldBlock]

Intimidating Strike.name: Intimidating Strike
Intimidating Strike.description: The Hellknight field-maralictor makes a melee Strike. If it hits and deals damage, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical hit.

Maralictor's Command.name: Maralictor's Command
Maralictor's Command.description: The Hellknight field-maralictor shouts a command to an ally of their choice. That ally can spend a reaction to Stride and Strike. The ally becomes immune to Maralictor's Command for 24 hours.

Warding Shift.name: Warding Shift
Warding Shift.description:
Requirements The Hellknight fieldmaralictor is adjacent to a willing ally

Effect The Hellknight field-maralictor moves an adjacent willing ally 5 feet in any direction and can Step into the space the ally vacated.
